articleTitle: Influence of Temperature and Humidity on IGBT Module Internal Stress
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: IGBT modules are playing an increasingly important role, and their internal stress often affects the operating status and lifespan. This paper takes Infineon FF300R17KE3 IGBT module as the research object. Based on “Ansys”, an IGBT module simulation model under the coupling of electro, thermal and mechanical fields is established to simulate IGBT module under the operating state of power cycle conditions. By changing the simulation boundary conditions, this paper explores how the ambient temperature and humidity affect the internal stress of IGBT module, and compares changes in IGBT module junction temperature and internal stress under ambient temperature of 0°C, 25°C, and 50°C respectively. Then, change the humidity conditions while the ambient temperature is 25°C still. The IGBT module under dry air, normal humidity air and saturated air are simulated respectively, and the changes of stress are compared. The simulation results show that the stress of each part of the IGBT module will increase with the increase of ambient temperature. The ambient humidity has relatively small effect on the stress.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Gravity Energy Storage Matrix System for New Energy Power Stations in Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy in the power system, the impact of the fluctuation of new energy output power on the power system cannot be ignored. In the new energy power stations, the energy storage (ES for short) system and the new energy generator can work together to effectively smooth the active power output of the new energy power generation system and improve the power quality, which plays a very important role in the efficient, stable operation and safe grid connection of the new energy power generation system. The gravity ES system has the characteristics of simple principle, long service life, and is not affected by geography and temperature, which is extremely suitable for application in the cold regions in northern China. According to the characteristics and ES requirements of new energy power stations, a gravity energy storage matrix system (GESMS for short) composed of multiple ES units is introduced, and the network topology of this system and the new energy generators is designed. On this basis, the charging and discharging and safety coordination control strategy between the GESMS and the new energy generators is designed to realize the coordinated operation of the GESMS and the new energy power stations.

articleTitle: Study on Current Controller of Doubly-Fed Induction Generator with Variable Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, current control strategy has played an important role in power system stability analysis. Based on the doubly-fed wind turbine model, the effects of PI- R, PI, IP and adaptive control strategies on the dynamic performance of the system are analyzed and compared. In this paper, the mathematical model of the doubly-fed induction generator is established in the rotating d-q axis frame, and the transfer function of the current controller is deduced and analyzed. On this basis, four current control strategy models are established. The simulation results show that all the control systems have strong robustness when the parameters are uncertain. Moreover, compared with other control strategies, PI-R has better dynamic performance. This method can solve the control problem of wind power system based on DFIG under unbalanced loads and nonlinear loads.

articleTitle: DC-Link Voltage Control and Power Management of BESS Integrated Wind Power System Using PSCAD
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The rapid growth of wind energy presents both opportunities and challenges for power systems. Sudden changes in wind speed can lead to fluctuations in power generation, making it challenging to match the supply with the demand in real-time. Due to fluctuating wind characteristics, incorporating power from the wind turbines in the electrical grid has an effect on the power quality. The long-term unpredictability of renewable energy source, like wind, makes a certain amount of energy storage necessary. Previous wind power systems are operating without storage techniques because of some technical concerns like grid has to be expanded, modernized, and one has to take measures to control or stabilize the grid during off peak and on peak load conditions. This has been done by implementing multi-source converter control topology. A multisource converter based battery storage system as a secondary power source is a good approach for making wind turbines dispatchable because of the fact that battery storage act as a constant voltage source by offering a quick response in either charging or discharging. In this research, a simulation model is developed in which a battery energy storage system integrated at the DC-link of a Type-4 wind turbine. A control system is designed to control the power output to the grid depending upon the grid power requirements and wind power production by charging or discharging the battery storage system while also keeping a stable DC-link voltage. The simulation results illustrate the control of DC-link integrated battery energy storage system at different set point wind speeds and set point grid power as well as with time-series wind data. At the end SOC permit control approach has also been illustrated. All of these have been analyzed in PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Level Collaborative Scheduling Model Based on Distributed Power Connected to the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: After the distributed power supply connects to the new power system, the power grid scheduling is affected by voltage flash during the grid scheduling, resulting in an increase in operating costs of the power grid. It is proposed that the high -penetration distribution power supply connects the diversified electric energy dual -layer scheduling method of the new power system. After mastering the current adjustment of the load and credible contribution information of the power grid, this paper builds a multi -purpose power system diversified power dual-layer scheduling model based on multi -target optimization. The upper layer scheduling target of this model is to optimize the quality of diversified electricity. The lower layer scheduling goal is to maximize the economic benefits of the new power system. The minimum value method can be solved to achieve the upper and lower target functions. The system schedules the optimal solution to ensure that under the access to high penetration distributed power supply, to ensure the maximization goal of the economic benefits of the power grid, it reasonably dispatches the displacement of the distributed power supply, and realizes the optimization of the diversified power quality of the new power system. The experimental results show that under the scheduling of this method, the voltage offset of the photovoltaic grid system is reduced by 0.60 MV. The operating cost of the new power system is also effectively controlled. Compared with that before the scheduling, this method is available.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on Local Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper employs the Center Symmetric Local Binary Pattern (CSLBP) algorithm for extracting fine features in facial expression recognition. Additionally, the Rotation Invariant Local Phase Quantization (RILPQ) algorithm is utilized to capture accurate features for recognizing blurry facial expressions. The proposed approach achieves comprehensive and detailed extraction of different facial expression features. By constructing a multi-nonlinear SVM classifier structure model, the system accomplishes the classification of facial expression features and facilitates facial recognition. The experimental statistical data indicates that our algorithm is most suitable for a 9×9 pixel block grid. The accuracy of facial expression feature extraction is around 92%, and the accuracy of facial expression classification and recognition is also approximately 92%. For images with an 8×8 feature dimension, the algorithm's processing time is approximately 0.23 seconds.

articleTitle: Double Fuzzy PID Control in PMLSM Variable Theory Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the undesirable characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMLSM) in the process of movement, such as parameters easy to change, easy to be interfered by sudden load changes, nonlinearity, strong coupling, etc., the fuzzy control idea of variable theory domain is introduced on the premise of the mathematical model of magnetic field oriented permanent magnet synchronous linear motor. This paper constructs the input fuzzy domain expansion factor rule table, uses the fuzzy rules to adjust the expansion factor in real time, changes the fuzzy PID control input fuzzy domain, and realizes the proportional, integral, and differential parameter self-adjustment. The experiments are simulated by MATLAB, and the research results show that the dynamic response speed and robustness of the double fuzzy variable theory domain PID control system are improved compared with the traditional fuzzy PID control and the triple fuzzy variable theory domain PID control.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Smart Grid Digital System Based on Big Data Cloud Computing Model Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: An intelligent power business development method based on digital service information is proposed. At the same time, a complete data mining framework is constructed. Parameters such as distance of adjacent pixels, similarity degree of carrier components and average amplitude were determined by coding and parsing. Then the digital business information resources are extracted. The mining method of data cloud in power system based on time series is established. The correlation degree of each information characteristic of middle station is analyzed based on classification and characteristic identification of power system middle station. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively improve the distribution of data in the middle station in every minute. The standard deviation of the algorithm is reduced and the mining effect is improved.

articleTitle: An Impedance Identification Method for New Energy Grid-tied Inverter System Based on GA-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Traditional impedance models primarily consist of analytical models and black-box models. However, analytical modeling is limited by the disclosure information provided by inverter manufacturers. As the artificial intelligence algorithms develop, there are impedance models for inverters based on back propagation neural networks (BPNN). These models address the drawbacks of missing parameters and perturbation injection, thus minimizing undesired effects. But the BPNN structure design has inherent flaws, often leading to local optima and non-converging error results, consequently affecting the accuracy of impedance identification. In this paper, a novel impedance identification method utilizing a genetic algorithm combined with BPNN (GA-BPNN) is proposed. It involves using the genetic algorithm (GA) to select optimal weights and thresholds for the BPNN. This method significantly improves the accuracy of impedance identification results while retaining the benefits of BPNN modeling.

articleTitle: YOLO-Based Binocular Ranging Method: Towards Depth Perception and Object Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer vision and deep learning, binocular ranging technology has become an important means to achieve depth perception and object localization. In this paper, we propose a binocular ranging method based on YOLO (You Only Look Once), which achieves accurate 3D object ranging and localization by combining depth estimation and target detection. We adopt YOLOv5 as the basic target detection framework and make a series of improvements and optimizations based on it. Experimental results show that our method achieves good ranging and localization performance on binocular image datasets with high accuracy and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Method Based on Autoencoder and LSTNet Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The accuracy of load forecasting is very important to the safe and economical operation of power system. This paper presents a LSTNet model based on Autoencoder feature extraction for load time series prediction. In this model, the Autoencoder extracts the key features of the electrical load time series data by minimizing the reconstruction error, encodes these features into a lower-dimensional vector, and inputs the features into the LSTNet model after dimensionality reduction for network training and prediction. The experimental results show that the Autoencoder-based LSTNet model has more advantages than the traditional LSTNet model and the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network model in the Tianjin electric load forecasting task, and the prediction accuracy is increased by about 1.5% in the experimental case. This study provides a new method for power system load forecasting and demonstrates the potential of Autoencoders and LSTNet models.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Grid Network Access System Based on Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Facial recognition technology is a key technology to achieve secure access to power grid. Among them, the recognition method based on Adaboost model is fast, but the accuracy is not high. Although deep neural network has high recognition accuracy, its detection speed is slow. In this paper, an online face recognition algorithm suitable for a single regional power grid is studied based on the power grid access characteristics. This integrated system helps substation personnel reduce communication costs. In this way, equipment maintenance checks, equipment current status checks and substation area physical integrity checks are completed. Experiments show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve a computation rate of 30 FPS on CPU and maintain a high accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Method for Data Retrieval Intent Recognition Targeting Complex Grid Control Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the power system develops and the power grid scales up, power grid control becomes more complex. This paper proposes a data retrieval intent recognition method for the complex power grid control business. Through TF-IDF and SimHash algorithms, a high-quality word family is constructed, considering keyword frequency and importance in the corpus, while retaining similarity information between keywords. By building an associative database and performing TF-IDF+Word2Vec text feature extraction, the system establishes an associative graph between historical data and the word family, forming superior text feature vectors for robust intent recognition support. Finally, emoBERT and TextCNN algorithms are used for intent recognition and classification, swiftly and accurately identifying input text intent, providing crucial information for power dispatch decision-making. Experimental results demonstrate an accuracy of over 94.7% on the dataset, showing feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Improved Hybrid Worm Propagation Model Based on Epidemic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: On the basis of analysing existing epidemic models such as SEM, SIR, and two-factor, by defining four major host state types, namely Susceptible, Infected, Anti-worm and Recovered, and by introducing two major influencing factors, namely, the host destruction of battlefield network and security measures, an improved hybrid worm mathematical model is constructed. Besides, the worm propagation effect is simulated and verified based on MATLAB.

articleTitle: Frequency Analysis Method of Minute Time Scale Based on Boiler Aggregation in Primary Frequency Regulation Scene
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Thermal power unit is particularly important, for the boiler pressure affects primary frequency regulation characteristics. The existing method of generator aggregation only focuses on the generator itself, and does not consider the boiler connected to the steam turbine. In fact, the primary frequency regulation capacity of the system is positively related to the thermal storage capacity of the boiler. It is of great significance to accurately analyze minute time scale frequency response by considering the boiler model. This paper proposes a weighted method to aggregate boiler heat storage dynamics, and analyzes frequency response on the scale of minute time. The correctness of the proposed method is verified by Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent UAV Communication Control System Based on Computer Optoelectronic Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A uniaxial optical probe is used to correct the longitudinal deviation of the Angle of view. A method for correction of side deviation of visual field during course adjustment of unmanned aircraft is proposed. A PID control method based on fuzzy neural network is proposed. The mathematical model of unmanned aircraft with six degrees of freedom is established. A new type of high-precision flight platform is designed. For the uncertain external parameters of the camera, a method based on video sequence is proposed. The attitude measurement of PTZ camera is completed. This method can ensure that the target is always in the image center position of the camera when tracking the target. Through computer simulation and real machine test, it is proved that the designed controller has better dynamic performance under strong interference conditions. This method can solve the coupling problem between the attitude channels of UAVs and achieve better control effect.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Telemetry Model for Computer Remote Network Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Using network architecture and WSBPEL process model, texture relationships in remote sensing images were studied. This project focuses on the solution of large-scale data access, network resource utilization and program scalability. This project intends to study the amplitude-frequency, phase and group delay characteristics of PCM/FM reentry remote sensing signal under multi-path interference, as well as the effects of amplitude distortion, delay distortion, channel attenuation coefficient, coding rate and other factors on reception performance. The results show that the amplitude distortion generally has no effect on the signal demodulation. The combined action of delay distortion and channel attenuation factor will change the performance boundary of the receiver.

articleTitle: Design of valley current sensing with low output voltage ripple based on CMCOT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In conventional ripple-based constant on-time (RB-COT) architectures, output voltage ripple depended on the equivalent series resistance (ESR) of output capacitance. Smaller ESR could cause sub-harmonic oscillation to the system loop. And larger ESR could increase the output voltage ripple and reduce the conversion efficiency under heavy load. Therefore, the valley current sensing based on COT mode control is proposed, and the output voltage ripple is replaced by the sensing inductor current ripple. The current of the low-side MOSFET at the SW port is sensed by the current sensing circuit to generate a sensed voltage containing the sensed current ripple information. Then the voltage is compared with the control signal, so as to adjust the output voltage through the system loop, reduce the output voltage ripple, and improve the stability and conversion efficiency of the system under heavy load. The chip was fabricated using a 0.18μm 30V BCD process. For an input voltage of 12 V and an output voltage of 3.3V, when the load current varied from 0.6 A to 3.3A and the temperature was 25 °C, the output voltage ripple was less than 7mV,which could achieve low output voltage ripple. And the maximum conversion efficiency of the system could reach 97%, meeting the requirements of system stability.

articleTitle: Implementation and System Design of Power Dispatching Algorithm Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: An automatic control system for full multi-network peaking scheduling is proposed. Under the control architecture of cloud platform, the balance between multi-power network automatic scheduling module and peaking actuator is coordinated. The hardware operating environment of power network dispatching system is constructed. Then, by using the decomposition of the end structure of the component, the occurrence pattern of the carrier side peaking command of the power line is improved. According to the turnaround time of multi-network control commands, the data loop operation flow is optimized, and the corresponding software running environment is constructed, thus ensuring the normal operation of the automatic control system of multi-network power system. The simulation test shows that the stability of the unit operation mode is poor, and the data period of peak load control is long after adopting this scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Field Optimization of Dual Body Ultra-High Voltage Shunt Reactors Based on Magnetic Shunt Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the optimization of the magnetic shunt structure for ultra-high voltage oil-immersed dual-body reactors. Firstly, a three-dimensional finite element simulation model was established for the reactors with rectangular and arc-shaped magnetic shunt configurations, and a magnetic field calculation method was proposed based on this model. Subsequently, the influence of magnetic shunt structure parameters on the maximum magnetic field was investigated. By varying parameters such as magnetic shunt thickness, radius, and side length, the distribution of the primary magnetic flux inside the reactor under different magnetic shunt structures was compared. Based on the research findings, an optimized design scheme for the magnetic shunt was proposed. Comparative analysis with existing magnetic shunt design schemes for reactors demonstrated that the proposed magnetic shunt structure reduced the maximum value of the arc-shaped magnetic shunt by 14.95% and the rectangular magnetic shunt by 16.84%, while maintaining the average value of the primary magnetic flux essentially unchanged. Furthermore, the proposed design achieved a more uniform distribution of the primary magnetic flux inside the reactor. This study provides valuable insights for the optimization of the magnetic shunt structure in ultra-high voltage oil-immersed reactors within the field of electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Multiscale Feature Hand Pose Estimation Guided by Variable Hand Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the realm of computer image processing, 3D hand pose estimation has found applications across various domains of human-computer interaction and virtual reality (VR). Most existing models are computationally expensive due to their spatial redundancy. In this paper, we introduce the Variable Skeleton Hand Network, a precision-focused and computationally efficient model for 3D hand joint coordinate regression. This model leverages a normalized point cloud and a 2D variable skeleton as inputs. We instantiate the model using a deformable hand skeleton in conjunction with a two-stage folding decoder. We propose the use of a multiscale single finger local decoder composed of global features and finger localized features for higher accuracy hand pose estimation. Experimental results on the ICVL and MSRA datasets show that our model achieves an error of 6.03 mm and 7.18 mm, respectively, compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Workpiece Recognition and Localization Based on Binocular Stereoscopic Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To enhance the intelligence of robots during their operational processes, research has been conducted on the recognition and positioning of workpieces using binocular stereoscopic vision. A binocular vision system model was constructed, and calibration of the binocular system was performed to obtain camera parameters, relative poses, and distortion coefficients. During image preprocessing, the Canny operator was employed for edge detection to extract the edges of the workpiece. A contour tracing algorithm was utilized to obtain the outer contour of the workpiece, which was then enclosed by a minimum bounding rectangle to obtain the region of individual workpieces. The Bouguet algorithm was applied for linear rectification of the binocular stereoscopic vision. Leveraging the inherent principle of disparity in binocular vision systems, depth information in the depth direction was obtained, and by combining the two-dimensional coordinates with the depth distance values, the three-dimensional coordinates of the target were determined. Multiple experimental results have demonstrated that the algorithm proposed in this paper meets the requirements for practical positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of Digital Twin of Lithium Battery Based on Data-Model Hybrid Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Lithium battery, as an important part of new energy storage, its scientific and safe use and management has become a key factor to achieve low-carbon technology. Lithium-ion battery is a highly nonlinear system, and its operating state is susceptible to environmental interference and other disturbances, resulting in errors. Aiming at the error caused by the disturbance of the running state of lithium battery, this paper proposes a method of digital twin modeling of lithium-ion battery which integrates the mechanism model and the data-driven model. The adaptive particle swarm optimization support vector machine regression (SVR) algorithm was used to conduct data-driven modeling for the errors between the mechanism model and the battery entity data, and the errors were corrected to obtain a real-time and high-precision battery model, which realized condition monitoring and offline simulation display. Moreover, the accuracy of the model was verified through experiments, proving that it can lay a foundation for the safe and intelligent management and control of the battery system.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Intelligent Grasping of Robotic Arm Based on Machine Vision Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the economic and social development of human beings, people have higher and higher requirements for the intelligence of machinery and equipment. With the vigorous development of robot vision technology, robots are becoming more and more widely used in various industries, and they also gradually have “eyes”. This not only broadens the scope of its use, but also improves its intelligence. In this paper, the PUMA-560 manipulator was simulated to realize its visual recognition and grasping functions. It has been applied to the original industrial robots. For example, the six-axis manipulator used this time is to obtain relevant information about the target and the surrounding environment through computer vision technology, so as to accurately identify the action to be carried out, and respond according to the action to guide the robot to grasp.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Engineering Interconnection Technology for Intelligent Gateway of Power Distribution IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Intelligent gateway is an edge device in the architecture of distribution Internet of Things, and detection is an important means of quality control. At present, the research mainly focuses on the technology of access detection and arrival detection. As a link in the whole life cycle of intelligent gateway, there was no research of engineering joint inspection technology before installation. Therefore, this paper studies the technology of engineering interconnection technology for intelligent gateway. Firstly, according to the debugging requirements of intelligent gateway, the “cloud + distributed” joint commissioning architecture is designed to provide a real environment for intelligent gateway project joint commissioning. Secondly, the process of automatic closed-loop joint debugging of intelligent gateway is described in detail, and the hardware and software of the test bench of intelligent gateway are designed to realize the automatic joint debugging of intelligent gateway. Finally, the feasibility of the intelligent gateway project combined with the application of the interconnection is verified to help the development of the distribution Internet of things.

articleTitle: Long Term Electricity Consumption Forecast Based on DA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Electricity consumption is the barometer and weathervane of economic development. In this research, a deep learning long term electricity consumption prediction model based on data enhancement is proposed, and the long term power time series is investigated by using the deep learning method and data enhancement techniques. Firstly, the monthly power quantity is upsampled by interpolation method to generate data with finer granularity, and data points are extracted at equal intervals to form a data series with the same dimension as the original data. Secondly, the augmented data are used as inputs to the deep learning model, so as to allow the deep learning model to have a better generalization ability in the presence of more training data, thus attenuating the over fitting problem of the model. The deep learning model is adopted respectively. LSTM model, Bi-LSTM model, GRU model and MLP model were used. Finally, the model was verified to have a high prediction accuracy using the electricity consumption of urban residents in a province.

articleTitle: Simulation for Power Characteristics of Vibration Dampers Based on Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The vibration damper represents the most extensively utilized and efficacious active measure for vibration control in current practice, boasting a track record spanning several decades of application both in China and abroad. It has proven markedly effective in diminishing or entirely eradicating the detrimental impacts associated with the vibrations in transmission conductors. This device is capable of substantially reducing the maximum double amplitude of conductor vibrations to a mere fraction, often to as little as one-tenth or less. The anti-vibration performance of the vibration damper is closely related to its power characteristics. In this article, the forces acting on the vibration damper clamp were analyzed, and the differential equation for the free vibrations in the vibration damper is derived. The mathematical model for power characteristics of vibration dampers were proposed, and the accuracy of the model was verified by comparing to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Edge Active Perception Safety Monitoring System Based on Video Fusion Multi-Target
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This project aims to develop an ultra-high voltage transmission company monitoring center, using STM32F407 microcontroller as the core, combined with wireless ZigBee sensor network, in order to achieve real-time monitoring of transmission lines. The system design follows the principle of modularity to ensure the flexibility and scalability of the system. The main contents include the overall design of the system, the selection and configuration of the sensor, the method of data acquisition and the design of the monitoring interface. The monitoring system can monitor the key parameters of the UHV transmission line in real time, such as temperature, pressure and humidity, and transmit the data to the monitoring center through a wireless sensor network. Through the real-time analysis of the collected data, the monitoring center can fully grasp the status of the transmission line and ensure the transmission safety. In addition, this project also proposes a security state recognition method based on multi-feature fusion. The method classifies the features by cluster analysis, reduces the dimensionality of key data by manifold learning, and obtains the detailed information of each monitoring point. Through the convolution operation of the original monitoring data, all kinds of features are classified according to the same proportion, and the classified data is fused to achieve the integration of multi-source data. The system also divides the collected data flow into data Windows of a specific period, and senses the working state of the transmission line in real time by comparing and analyzing the feature changes in the adjacent Windows.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Algorithm for Smart Edge Sensing Device Distribution Optimization for Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: There are many sensing nodes in the industrial park system, and the amount of data uploaded at the same time is huge, the concurrency requirements are high, and the sensing loss is large. Therefore, the cloud-edge collaborative multi-processing architecture is built, which includes decentralized data aggregation of edge sensing nodes, partition data processing, and cloud data comparison. In this paper, a cloud-edge collaborative multi-processing architecture of edge sensing node decentralized data aggregation, partition data processing and cloud data comparison is constructed, and a unified point distribution principle is designed. Under the typical area scale of the multi-processing architecture, combined with the requirements of obtaining the minimum sensing devices and the maximum characteristic information in the multi-processing architecture area, the optimization design of the layout scheme was carried out based on the constraint conditions of all sensing devices in the coverage area, and the physical relationship model of the transmitted power and coverage radius of the sensing devices was constructed. Considering the deployment scheme of field sensing nodes and the coupling relationship between different indicators, a two-stage sensor location strategy based on a variety of heuristic algorithms was designed, and a two-stage location optimization method with minimum power initial location + fitness correction was proposed, which effectively reduced the coverage overlap area of regional sensing collection equipment and constructed a location energy consumption model.

articleTitle: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis in Korean Based on Hierarchical Masking and Aspect-aware Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) is considered a pivotal component of fine-grained sentiment analysis, focusing on predicting the sentiment polarity of a specific aspect within a given context. However, existing models for aspect-level sentiment analysis often fall short in seamlessly integrating the local semantic details of aspect words with the broader semantic context. In response, we introduce a novel model called Hierar-chical Masking and Aspect-aware Attention (HMAA). This model aims to depict nuanced relationships between opinion words and aspects, while also considering the overall sentiment tendencies of sentences.HMAA incorporates a hierarchical masking module that emphasizes diverse combinations of aspect words and their surrounding context. Additionally, an aspect-aware attention module is devised to comprehensively grasp the connections between aspect words and sentences on a global scale. The local context semantics collaboratively interact with the aspect-aware attention network for the final sentiment classification. Experimental validation on multiple Korean-language datasets demonstrates the efficacy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Target Defect Detection Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces a defect detection system based on YOLOv5 and K-Means clustering algorithm, aimed at efficiently and accurately detecting surface flaws in targets. In the context of high costs, complex operations, and stringent environmental requirements posed by traditional flaw detection methods, this system integrates deep learning technology and an optimized K-Means algorithm, significantly enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of the YOLOv5 model in steel flaw detection. Innovations to the original backbone network of YOLOv5 include the addition of multi-layer upsampling, effectively improving the detection capability for flaws of various scales. Furthermore, by augmenting the target flaw dataset, this system not only enriches the sample volume but also strengthens feature extraction capabilities by integrating novel convolutional structures and an improved attention mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in average precision and recall rates for the modified YOLOv5 detection model on the flaw dataset, achieving 70% of the original model's detection speed and fully meeting the requirements for flaw detection in industrial production settings.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Supply Chain Management System Based on Computer Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies the application of blockchain-based smart contracts in power grids. The access method of IPFS hash addressing can enable all kinds of users in the power system to access according to their own rights. A grid supply chain information management platform has ability to handle different types of information with trust. Trusted information sharing can be guaranteed within the scope of complete security and transparency. This paper studies the data block generation method in the energy information fusion system. A message passing method based on intra-node queue generated by blocks is proposed to improve the rate of data block construction in information fusion system. The integration of the characteristics of the privacy blockchain with attribute authentication technology ensures the real-time transmission and storage of information. The proposed method is tested by 5 IEEE standard examples. Experiments show that the proposed method greatly reduces the speed of data block construction and improves the transmission efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation System Based on Power Dispatching Rule Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of power systems, the requirements for grid dispatchers are also increasing. The existing simulation evaluation methods rely too much on instructors and have been difficult to meet the needs of dispatcher simulation training. This article studies and develops an intelligent evaluation system based on the knowledge base of power dispatching rules. By constructing a knowledge base of power dispatching rules, the system can evaluate the standardization and effectiveness of the dispatcher's simulation practice behavior, improve the efficiency and effectiveness of grid dispatcher simulation training. It can also rapidly improve the work skills and comprehensive quality of grid dispatchers, and provide talent guarantee and intellectual support for the safe and stable operation of the grid.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Simulation Calculation of Marine Sextant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: If you check the Index mirror of marine sextant from different angle, you will get different result. To solve the problem of marine sextant, in this article the checking method and principle of index mirror is analyzed, the problem existing in the design of marine sextant is studied. The method of simulation is adopted to calculate the vertical error of index mirror, and calculate the corresponding height measurement error, the poor distribution is formulated. The result to improve the measurement precision has very important practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on Computer-Controlled Thrust Clearance Detection System Based on Micro Grating Ruler
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Slave FIFO method is used to realize the interface programming of thrust gap detection of grating pump unit, which mainly involves the upper computer of precision detection system and the USB interface programming of data acquisition module. The system interface adopts USB transmission mode, and the interface chip adopts Cypress CY7C68013 chip. The interface program of the main pump motor thrust gap measurement system based on Slave FIFO mode is designed, which involves firmware program design and communication interface program design of upper computer. Dynamic parameters such as velocity and acceleration are used to measure the grating displacement. The dynamic error detection system of grating ruler based on precision air float guide is designed and optimized with the aim of error minimization. The dynamic measurement of grating with high precision can solve the displacement testing requirements of large main pump platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Robustness of Behavior Recognition Model in Power Safety Monitoring Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of power systems and the deepening of power safety supervision work, it is particularly important to effectively identify and monitor the behavior of power safety supervision personnel. This research aims to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of personnel behavior recognition in the field of electric power safety supervision through advanced neural network technology. First, this study conducts an in-depth analysis of the common behaviors of electric power safety supervisors, including daily inspections, accident handling, equipment maintenance and other tasks. On this basis, a behavior recognition model based on neural network algorithm is proposed. This model combines deep learning and pattern recognition methods and can accurately classify various behaviors of power safety supervisors. Secondly, a large amount of field data was used for training and testing in the study to ensure the robustness and generalization ability of the model. Furthermore, this study focuses on the real-time and adaptability of the algorithm. Taking into account the particularity of power safety supervision, by adjusting the structure and parameters of the neural network, the algorithm can perform behavior recognition more efficiently in real-time scenarios, and the training of neural networks optimizes the performance of the algorithm. Experiments have proven that the proposed behavior recognition model based on neural network algorithm has high accuracy and robustness in classifying human behavior.

articleTitle: A Digital Trimming Circuit with Pre-Trimming Function
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems that conventional digital trimming circuits are unable to predict the trimming result after the fuse is melted and that the actual trimming value deviates from the expected trimming value, a digital trimming circuit with a pre-trimming function is proposed. The circuit is based on the idea of pin multiplexing, and the trim signal is input through the function pins of the chip. By controlling the digital trimming circuit to simulate the trimming result after the polysilicon fuses are melted, the optimal trimming scheme is determined. The pre-trimming design improves the accuracy of the trimming. The design of the ending fuse can avoid the problem of false trimming caused by input signal fluctuation during normal operation of the circuit. The circuit is realized based on a 0.18 μm 30V BCD (Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS) process. Simulation results show that the design is able to meet the design expectations.

articleTitle: Research on UFS Firmware Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of slow data transmission in large capacity storage media UFS in vehicle domain controllers, this paper proposes a firmware optimization method that improves code execution efficiency and saves code execution time by regrouping firmware level codes; At the same time, by storing the optimal voltage in the chip, the time to find the optimal voltage is reduced. The experimental results indicate that the data transmission speed of UFS is significantly improved during low-temperature shock starting.

articleTitle: Automatic Power Direction Control of DAB Converter in Emergency Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the advantage of any direction of power flow of dual active bridge (DAB) converter, DAB converter can be applied in the energy router as the DC/DC transfer part for emergency energy supply to deal with the unexpected large power outage. Not only they can make sure the various power energy supplies, but also ensure the high-power conversion. However, the power direction of DAB converter is adjusted through changing the value of phase shift angle between the gate signals of switches which is controlled manually. Based on above reason, this paper proposes an automatic power direction control method of DAB converter to make the bidirectional power transmission be done automatically without manual adjustment which significantly eliminates the constant human supervision and simplifies the operation. Ultimately, a comprehensive demonstration of the MATLAB/Simulink test is conducted to substantiate the viability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Factors of Winding Hot Spot Temperature of Oil-immersed Transformer Based on Oil Baffle Position
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the heat transfer mechanism and thermal conduction path of the oil-immersed forced oil circulation transformer, a 240000KVA, 330KV oil-immersed power transformer with forced oil circulation is taken as a research object in the paper. The axial repeatability of the transformer is considered, and the transformer winding oil path model is simplified and analyzed. The influence rule of the position of the oil baffle, the number of guiding zones, and the height of the horizontal oil passage on the hot point temperature of the transformer winding are explored by the finite element three-dimensional simulation analysis. The simulation results have a positive effect on improving the cooling structure and reducing the winding temperature.

articleTitle: Optimized operation strategy of pumped storage-electrochemical energy storage for renewable energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Since the large-scale connection of renewable energy to the grid will lead to the abandonment of wind and light energy, this paper investigates a strategy for optimizing the joint operation of pumped storage hydro and electrochemical energy storage plants in terms of renewable energy consumption. First, an optimization model for the joint operation of pumped storage hydro and electrochemical energy storage is proposed based on grid abandonment. Then, based on this, an electrochemical energy storage optimization method is proposed to meet the demand of power abandonment rate of the grid, taking into account the pumped storage hydro. Finally, the problem is solved with YALMIP + CPLEX. The results show that energy wastage can be reduced by rationally organizing the joint operation of a pumped storage hydro and electrochemical energy storage, and the need for a pumped storage power plant with an inverter is also confirmed.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method and System for Synchronous Condenser Based on Multi-Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The fault diagnosis system proposed in the article comprehensively utilizes forward and backward reasoning, experts on-site diagnosis rules and grey correlation analysis methods to calculate the correlation and credibility between diagnostic results and symptom data. This improves the real-time and accuracy of the vibration fault diagnosis of the synchronous condenser shaft system, and this is very valuable in eliminating potential equipment failures.

articleTitle: Research on Selection Technology of General Current and Voltage Transformer Equipment in Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the large-scale construction of power grid, the technical parameters of transformer equipment are more and more diversified and complicated. Through the study of the main technical parameters of transformer equipment in 35~750kV substation, the optimization selection should be 7 or 9 windings about the winding number of current transformer with voltages of 330kV and above, the winding number should be maximum configuration to 6 windings with voltages of 220kV and below. The maximum rated burden for current transformer with a rated secondary current of 1A is 15 VA. In addition to converter transformer alternating current side, the secondary windings of voltage transformers can be uniformly optimized to 4 windings with an accuracy class of 0.2/0.5(3P)/0.5(3P)/3P. The optimal selection parameters of voltage transformer rated capacity and secondary burden are studied and proposed. General transformer equipment selection technology can effectively improve the equipment quality and reliability.

articleTitle: Predicting Electric Vehicle Charging Load Using Graph Attention Networks and Autoformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), there is potential to alleviate the energy structure problem. However, this also intensifies pressure on the power supply side, making charging load prediction crucial with diverse application scenarios and significant commercial value. Most existing EV charging load forecasting methods focus on charging stations, neglecting user travel habits and charging needs. This paper introduces a temporal-spatial neural network model based on graph attention and Autoformer to forecast EV charging load, constructing a spatiotemporal graph dataset based on user travel trajectories. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively leverages the distribution of user clusters in both time and geographical space, leading to improved accuracy in charging load prediction.

articleTitle: A Container-Based Continuous Integration Development and Operations Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article proposes a platform of container-based continuous integration development and operations. It is a code continuous integration and automation operations platform based on the Kubernetes container environment. The platform leverage the capabilities and features of containers to achieve automation from development to deployment.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Problems and Rectification Measures of Acceptance in Power Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The safe and reliable operation of power equipment in power substation has an important influence on the reliability of power use. As an important check link of power substation environment and power equipment quality, the acceptance of power substation is very important. Based on the operation and maintenance experience of power substation, this paper studies the typical problems in the process of power substation acceptance, analyzes the possible impact of the problems, and puts forward the corresponding rectification measures. This paper has certain reference significance for power substation design, construction, acceptance, operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Sub-Pixel Arrangement Algorithm Based on Multi-View Autostereoscopic Three-Dimension Display Using a Slanted Lenticular Sheet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-view sub-pixel arrangement method based on multi-view autostereoscopic display. The traditional autostereoscopic display using lenticular sheet covers an integer number of sub-pixels and arranges the sub-pixels directly according to the order of view. This method is a generalized algorithm for arranging multi-view sub-pixels under conditions for slanted gratings. According to the number of views, the number of grating in the display unit and other related parameters, the optimal arrangement is calculated. Finally, experiments with 32 views and 3 sets of grating in the display unit verify that the sub-pixel arrangement results obtained by the algorithm can achieve the correct exit pupil distribution and a continuous parallax effect.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection Based on Label Reassembling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Owing to the complexity of surface defect morphologies, deep learning framework-based algorithms are usually able to obtain higher accuracy compared to traditional methods with hand-crafted features and gradually attract researchers' attention. However, considering the existing defect image data sets are usually small samples, overfitting is particularly liable to occur when the general classification model is adopted directly. To tackle this problem, we present a label reassembling-based surface defect detection. Specifically, the original label is reassigned to constructing a multi-task learning model, where the recombined label corresponds to the upstream auxiliary task to alleviate the overfitting problem. Finally, the experimental results on public datasets indicate that the improved method can reach better performance compared with MobileNetV2 which is used as the base model in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper uses mobile network mode to develop and model Python crawler based on Ubuntu16.04 and CUDA9.0. The visualization of this pattern was achieved using Tensor Board software. The hardware design of the system consists of three modules: linear array CCD sensor, DSP processor and signal processing circuit. Through the reconstruction and learning of such models, the trained models are stored, so as to obtain higher precision image recognition. A method of classifying objects using Fourier description operators is proposed. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the image is 96.8% and the recognition time is 0.55 seconds. Motion tracking is based on the positioning and capture of the specific position of the human hand in each screen, and the captured frame rate is 28 frames per second. The system can quickly acquire images of 1024*1500 pixels at a rate of 5 photos/second. Through the static identification of posture and tracking of motion trajectory, the interaction between human and machine is better.

articleTitle: A USBKEY Calling Method Based on IPSEC XFRM Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of hardware encryption and decryption by calling the hardware USB KEY under the XFRM framework of IPSEC. The XFRM framework configures the algorithm used by the protocol in the security association SA to call the kernel CRYPTO algorithm framework. The algorithm framework calls the hardware algorithm in the code, but only implements the algorithm module of the PCIE and APB bus, and does not implement the method call of USB. During ESP processing, the CRYPTO framework is in the process of network interrupt processing. Calling USB devices directly will generate new interrupts, leading to interrupt conflicts. If it is a single core embedded CPU, it will directly lead to kernel crash. Through the use of asynchronous algorithm registration, kernel thread call, URB framework adjustment, SG device node modification and other means, network interrupts can be released in a timely manner to solve the problem of soft interrupt conflicts, and the successful call to USB devices in the single core embedded CPU scenario can be achieved; Both kernel mode and user mode program calls are satisfied, and the functions are not affected by each other.

articleTitle: Application of Power Internet of Things Technology in Fault Diagnosis Platform for Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Synchronous condenser remote diagnosis platform is built under the background of the power Internet of Things technology, with the power grid as the hub, and through data warehouse and data replication technologies to build a data center, achieving the sharing and exchange of information data throughout the company. We apply advanced big data technology to mine operating data and build a reliable, secure, and linearly scalable big data system. With the help of data transformation, outliers can be handled, standardization, generalization, and data aggregation, the inference of fault diagnosis knowledge base will been carried out. Utilizing data warehouse and data mining technology to analyze various indicators in the operation, maintenance and management of the synchronous condenser, we could establish a safety warning evaluation system based on massive data, and combine system operation status estimation technology to ensure the health of the synchronous condenser, achieving precise prediction and coordinated control. Finally, a comparative analysis was conducted between the new system and the traditional status monitoring system, and the superiority of the new system is given.

articleTitle: Design of Multi View Natural Language Query System on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In various fields such as medical imaging, object detection, and video surveillance, multi view natural language query systems utilize image data to provide a more comprehensive perspective, allowing users to intuitively query and obtain information. Due to the lack of a deep understanding of natural language in the hard coded matching rule method, the query results do not match the user's intentions and are difficult to meet practical application needs. Therefore, this article introduces machine vision algorithms for optimization and improvement. This article first discusses the system architecture of four modules: data input and preprocessing, visual feature extraction, natural language understanding and matching, and result generation and feedback. Then, the application of machine vision technology in the system was analyzed using two calculation formulas: grayscale conversion and binarization, and natural language processing technology was briefly discussed. Subsequently, a context understanding module was added to construct a multi view natural language query system based on machine vision. Finally, two sets of simulation experiments were conducted to draw the following conclusion: compared with traditional methods, the overall average improvement in image recognition accuracy indicators is about 14.3%, while the overall average improvement in response speed indicators is about 26.5%. This research system can effectively process images from different perspectives and match them with natural language queries.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Single Indoor Image Based on Relational Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To address the problems of object scale discrepancies and insufficient detail precision in reconstructing indoor scenes using only one image in 3D, a method for 3D reconstruction that increases the proportion of geometric features is proposed. The method for 3D reconstruction is based on scene understanding and uses the spatial layout estimation module to obtain the layout information of the scene. The method adopts the relational network to allocate the relationships between objects and increases the weight of geometric features to deal with the problem of mismatches in target scales in the reconstruction based on a single image. The reconstructed surface of the object is calculated using the sign distance function, and the surface details of the resulting reconstruction are optimized by combining them with a Marching Cubes algorithm. The method has been shown to be capable of obtaining a reasonable-scale reconstructed object model and the detailed message of the model, as evidenced by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Safety of Aircraft Unmanned Tractor Based on DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In response to the immature problem in the field of unmanned path planning for civil passenger aircraft, in order to improve its safety, this paper proposes obstacle avoidance optimization for the path planning algorithm of unmanned towing vehicles by drawing on the motion planning of intelligent robots in two-dimensional space. Firstly, the DBSCAN clustering algorithm is used to preprocess and optimizes map obstacles in the global path planning stage. Secondly, the A-star algorithm is selected as the base algorithm for unmanned tractor path planning, and combined with the dynamic window method for algorithm fusion, further research is conducted in obstacle avoidance. After writing the code, the verification results were obtained through MATLAB simulation experiments and a conclusion was drawn: the improved A-star algorithm in this article has a significant effect on improving the safety of unmanned tractor path planning.

articleTitle: High Power Supply Signal Filtering Based on Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the polar-field high-power power supply system of a tokamak fusion device, key electrical signals such as voltage and current are inevitably affected by electromagnetic noise. To improve the control performance of the polar-field power supply system and reduce the number of triggering times of the protection mechanism, the electrical signals must be filtered after sampling to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the signals. In this study, a controlled step size LMS (Least Mean Square) algorithm based on the hyperbolic tangent function (tanh) was proposed, which adjusts the weight vector by constructing the affiliation function of the step size factor to balance the relationship between the convergence speed and the steady state error. In this study, taking control of the output signal of high power supply as the target, the simulation model was constructed to verify the algorithm's convergence speed and steady-state performance, and then experimental tests were carried out to verify the algorithm's feasibility. Moreover, the algorithm's delay is controlled at the nanosecond level, which gives the algorithm good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research and Validation of Scheduling Mechanism Based on Smart IoT Meter Operating System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to carry out an in-depth study on the scheduling mechanism based on the operating system of smart IoT meter and prove its effectiveness through experiments. Firstly, the characteristics and demands of smart IoT meter are analyzed, and the problems of traditional scheduling mechanism are discussed. Second, a scheduling mechanism based on smart IoT operating system is proposed to achieve efficient scheduling of smart IoT through reasonable task allocation and optimization algorithm. Finally, the performance data of the proposed scheduling mechanism is experimentally derived and analyzed in comparison with the traditional scheduling mechanism. The experimental results show that the designed scheduling mechanism of the smart IoT meter operating system meets the real-time requirements in terms of function and performance. Meanwhile, this study will also provide useful references for academic research and practical applications in the field of smart measurement device operating system.

articleTitle: Research on Train Energy Saving Optimization Problem Based on Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the gradual development of urban rail transit, the passenger flow of public transportation facilities increases, resulting in the rapid growth of energy consumption, which brings a significant burden to the sustainable development of the city. This paper explores the marching strategy to reduce the energy consumption of train operation through the study of a single train running between two stations, so as to further explore the potential of energy-saving and carbon-reducing of the train. A single-train multi-objective energy-saving optimization model is established, and a multi-objective genetic algorithm is used to solve for the lowest energy consumption and shortest running time of the train under the consideration of complex road conditions and the influence of complex dynamic processes of the motor. The BP neural network optimized by Gray Wolf algorithm is used to verify the solutions, and the minimum energy consumption is 2.0166e+12J and the shortest running time is 211.6529s.

articleTitle: Prediction of short-term photovoltaic power based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of photovoltaic power system, a short-term photovoltaic power prediction model based on Transformer is established. Firstly, the Pearson correlation analysis method is used to analyze the correlation of historical photovoltaic power data, and the historical data with high correlation is selected as the input. Then, the Transformer neural network is used to extract and analyze the photovoltaic time series characteristics. The multi-head self-attention mechanism realizes the model's grasp and application of key feature information and makes predictions. The photovoltaic power generation data of Dongying City in 2019 are selected for analysis. The simulation results show that the proposed Transformer short-term photovoltaic power prediction model has good prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Feedforward Suppression Strategy for Overvoltage Caused by Phase Angle Jumping after Short Circuit Fault Clearance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Ina system where Voltage-Sourced Converters (VSC) are connected to the grid through a phase-locked loop (PLL), the phase angle of the voltage at the point of common coupling (PCC) may jump when AC short-circuit fault clearing occurs. The PLL cannot achieve instantaneous phase locking due to its dynamic nature, which causes an inappropriate current injection of the VSC and thereby overvoltage at the PCC. Typically, the overvoltage lasts for about 100ms. To suppress the overvoltage, the mechanism of this overvoltage phenomenon is analyzed, and then, according to the derived overvoltage mechanism, a feedforward suppression strategy is proposed. Simulation verifications in DlgSILENT PowerFactory are carried out. Simulation results show that the proposed feedforward strategy can effectively suppress the overvoltage caused by the phase angle jumping when the short-circuit fault is cleared.

articleTitle: Research on Composite Control Method Without Position Sensor for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor at all Speed Ranges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the context of extremely low-speed operation, where velocities are at their absolute minimum, sensorless technology encounters additional losses and delays in position estimation when controlling permanent magnet synchronous motors, especially as we venture into the higher velocity spectrum, where the model parameters have a significant impact. In light of this, this study adopts a new algorithm built upon the principle of injecting high-frequency signals, utilizing a pulse modulated high-frequency voltage signal injection method based on position tracking. Combining model reference adaptive control and improved high-frequency signal injection methods, this paper introduces a holistic sensorless control scheme designed for the complete range of speeds. We established a simulation model in the Matlab/Simulink environment and conducted comparative analysis of the results. The research found that the proposed comprehensive control strategy can effectively identify motor speed and rotor position information, achieve smooth transitions between different speed ranges, enhance the system's dynamic response capability and speed regulation, while also improving the system's reliability.

articleTitle: Correlation between Respiratory Rate and EEG Signals Based on Wireless EEG Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Studies have shown that breathing is closely related to emotion regulation and cognition. Electroencephalography (EEG) records changes in electrical waves during brain activity, which can reflect mood swings and brain cognition. Previous researches have described that breathing is coupled with EEG signals. The aim of our study was to investigate the effects of different breathing rates on EEG signals. In this study, we first designed an experimental paradigm to guide EEG acquisition. After band-pass filtering, 9 kinds of EEG features were extracted from the 64 channel EEG signals. The paired T-test of at different breathing rates showed significant channels. The experimental results showed that the occipital region was the activated brain region corresponding to fast breathing, and there was no difference between slow breathing and normal breathing.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning-Based Recognition Technology for Violations in Live Electricity Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Safety management and control in live electricity operation sites constitute a crucial assurance component for electrical safety production. As the demand for live electricity operations continues to rise, accompanied by increased complexity and difficulty, the shift from manual video analysis to intelligent control methods in on-site safety management has become imperative. In response to this, a human body posture recognition technology is proposed, utilizing YOLOv8 to establish a multi-person posture recognition model. This, combined with traditional image recognition techniques, achieves comprehensive perception of personnel states, enabling real-time management and early warning of hazards and non-standard behaviors during operations. This approach alleviates the pressure on inspection personnel and enhances the intelligence of violation recognition in live electricity operation sites.

articleTitle: Agile Development Method Based on Django Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The development of Web System based on Django framework is fast. The classic MVC framework makes the whole system structure very clear, and each module performs its own duties and has a clear division of labor. In the process of software development, agile development method has become a popular development method. Agile development method emphasizes iteration, self-organization and rapid response to customer needs, which can improve the quality of software products and user satisfaction. The combination of Django framework and agile development can form a powerful combination, which can effectively help developers achieve their goals quickly and with high quality.

articleTitle: Research on Fast BP Imaging Algorithm of Short-Range Missile-Borne SAR Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For short-range synthetic aperture radar, the wavefront is needed to be processed strictly in accordance with spherical waves. BP algorithm is a vital technique to enable a short-range imaging scenario with no approximations and assumptions in its derivation. However, BP performs pixel-by-pixel processes, yields heavy computational burden and limits its realtime processing. To address these problems, a fast BP imaging algorithm for short-range missile-borne SAR based on attention mechanism is proposed. During this imaging processing, the targets range profiles after de-chirping are obtained by utilizing the range-direction pulse compression. Then by analyzing the range direction information, the regions where the target appears are used for the short-range SAR image reconstruction. Benefiting from the reducing the imaging area, the computational efficiency of back projection algorithm is greatly improved while ensuring the high azimuth. The BP fast imaging algorithm based on local attention has a speed-up factor proportional to the azimuth resolution compared to BP algorithm. The simulation demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency improvement of the proposed BP fast imaging algorithm based on local attention.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Power System Partitioning Method Based on Improved K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Grid zoning can simplify the process of grid analysis, and zonal control management is conducive to grid stability. This paper considers the homogeneity of power system unit operation, describes the principle of two-stage automatic partitioning method, and proposes the absolute spatial distance and frequency response trajectory deviation indexes according to the principle. This paper also proposes the two-stage partitioning method of provincial and local resources. The controllable regulation resources are partitioned by the improved K-means clustering method. A provincial power grid is analyzed as an example, and the results show that the unit division obtained by the proposed method has better uniformity.

articleTitle: Hardware and Thermal Design of Medium-low Speed Maglev Traction Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the core device of medium-low speed maglev trains, the traction converter plays a crucial role in energy conversion and drive control. Its design quality directly affects the performance and stable operation of the train.
