In this paper, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model and the Transformer classification model VIT are constructed respectively, and their performance is evaluated. And the performance of the two models is compared by training on different sized datasets. When the number of datasets is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.0\times 10^{4}$</tex>, the recognition accuracy of Transformer classification model VIT is higher than 90.2%, which effectively solves the problem of vessel recognition in remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Graph Attention Mechanism-Based Method for Tracing APT Attacks in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) attacks have become increasingly common. Detecting and responding to these attacks accurately and quickly is a research issue of great concern in the field of power system security. Currently, existing detection methods based on traceability graphs rely heavily on techniques such as label propagation algorithms and graph matching. These methods often require specialized domain knowledge and manually designed algorithmic rules. However, as deep learning technology continues to advance, reducing the dependence on human intervention becomes more important. In this paper, we propose a power system APT attack traceability method based on the graph attention mechanism. Our method involves preprocessing the original traceability graph using the data-prepare method to construct a dataset suitable for power system APT attack traceability processing. We then vectorize the attributes of nodes and edges of the traceability graph, and introduce the attention mechanism and hierarchical embedding strategy to aggregate the attack features into a graph-level representation. Finally, we train a graph classifier to achieve APT attack traceability for power systems through whole graph classification.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition Algorithm Based on Sparse Coding End-to-End Training
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study aims at improving traffic sign recognition accuracy at different angles of view and the recognition accuracy of the existing algorithms applied in identifying traffic signs with angular deformations. For this purpose, we put forward an end-to-end traffic sign recognition approach based on sparse coding. Coordinate relations of various features could be reserved depending on a CapsNet feature extraction layer that carries out joint discrimination by virtue of vector length and direction. In this way, the network's ability to discriminate samples with similar shapes was boosted on one hand; and on the other hand, the minimization problem solving process of sparse coding was converted into a multi-recurrent neural network layer. As a result, sparse coding with a stronger representation capability was obtained. Then, overall end-to-end supervised training was implemented in combination with multi-scale spatial pyramid pooling (SPP). Additionally, GTSRB and affine transformation datasets were selected to verify recognition accuracy of the proposed approach. According to relevant experimental results, recognition accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach are respectively up to 99.21% and 13fps at the GTSRB dataset. Moreover, objects deflected within an angle range of 60° can be effectively recognized.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Urban Water Supply Pipe Network Management System Based on Mobile GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Urban water supply pipe network system is a huge and complicated underground project. Water supply pipe network is buried deep underground for a long time, with wide distribution, complex structure and various materials. The water supply pipe network serves as the lifeblood of a city. In recent years, the problems of water supply network such as dispatching, leakage and control become more and more prominent, leading to the increasing demand for water supply network management and maintenance. The late start of infrastructure construction has greatly increased the difficulty of viewing and processing pipe network information, so that the traditional manual management mode is difficult to meet the demand. In response to the issues existing in the urban water supply pipe network, we developed GIS mobile terminal system of water supply pipe network based on database technology, GIS technology and ArcGIS technology. Using the Android mobile terminal as the platform, we employ modern terminal GPS positioning system technology and 5G network communication interaction to build an efficient, reasonable and practical GIS system of water supply network. The mobile terminal system enhances the operational and supervisory capabilities of the water supply pipe network, realizes the intelligent operation of urban water supply pipe network, and improves the level of water supply pipe network management and service. The system is mainly composed of four modules, basic map operation module, map display setting module, pipe network analysis module and route navigation module. The basic map operation module links various functions through the click function to analyze distance, area and other data for users. The map display setting module uses the layer control function and GIS technology to clearly display the layers and data required by the user. The functions of the pipe network analysis module provide users with pipe network management measures. The route navigation module uses GIS positioning function to provide navigation routes for users. All four modules utilize pipe network data for statistical analysis. Users can operate the four modules on the Android mobile client platform to make the dense water supply network clearly visible. Leveraging the portable and convenient features of the mobile terminal system, relevant government departments can promptly identify accidents, coordinate personnel quickly, and formulate and implement emergency plans

articleTitle: Research on Power Safety Monitoring Action Recognition Algorithm Through Neural Network and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studied the methods for improving the accuracy and efficiency of the action of power employees by deeply studying the application of neural network algorithm in power safety supervision video. Firstly, this paper summarizes the research status of power safety monitoring system and related action recognition algorithms. For the power industry, timely and accurate identification of workers' movements is essential for accident prevention and management. In this context, various motion recognition algorithms are emerging, among which neural network algorithm has attracted much attention due to its excellent performance in image processing and pattern recognition. Through deep learning, neural networks can automatically learn key features from a large number of video data, providing a more reliable means for human action recognition. Secondly, this paper introduces in detail the proposed method of power safety monitoring video personnel action recognition based on neural network algorithm. Through the optimization of neural network structure and the careful selection of training data, we construct an efficient and accurate action recognition model. The model can quickly and accurately identify the actions of different personnel at work by monitoring the video of electric power operation, including common operation actions and special actions in emergency situations. Our method can more comprehensively understand the various actions of personnel in the electric power environment. Through the analysis of a large number of experimental results, we verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm. Compared with traditional methods, the motion recognition algorithm based on neural network has achieved significant improvement in accuracy and response speed. This proves the practical application prospect of this method in the field of power safety supervision.

articleTitle: Implementation of medical image retrieval algorithm based on preference learning model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper utilizes the Stacked Denoising Auto Encoder (SDAE) model to capture the general edge features of images. Additionally, it employs the Convolutional Neural Networks model to extract fine edge features from medical images. By combining preference learning algorithms, the paper implements an image retrieval system and designs a medical image retrieval model termed SDAE+CNN+Preference Learning. In the design of the reconstruction residual function in the SDAE model, noise factors are introduced to ensure the accuracy of image feature extraction by accounting for the impact of noise. Adjustments have been made to the structure of the CNN model, specifically in the convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers. These adjustments aim to further enhance the accuracy of image feature extraction and ensure the precision of image feature classification. By conducting learning training on key parameters, an optimal preference learning model is obtained. Following the rules for matching the category attributes of input images with those in the medical image database and optimizing the loss function of the preference learning model, the similarity of category attributes for images is ranked. Ultimately, images with higher category attribute similarity are listed as retrieval results. Relevant experiments indicate that the proposed SDAE+CNN image feature extraction module in this paper achieves high accuracy in extracting image features, effectively controlling the influence of image noise; The designed SDAE+CNN+Preference Learning medical image retrieval model achieves a retrieval similarity of 96%, a retrieval accuracy of 94%, and a retrieval recall rate of 95%, as per the conducted experiments.

articleTitle: A User-Configurable and High-Reliability Transmission Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to solve the soft errors caused by the physical interaction of radiation particles with the device during data transmission, and at the same time to ensure the high reliability of data transmission, a user-configurable design for highly reliable transmission is proposed. Firstly, based on ten Gigabit Ethernet PHY controller, pseudo random bit stream generator and detector, bit error rate detector, watchdog and other modules are designed. Secondly, the gearbox is upgraded to design a highly reliable gearbox that satisfies the dynamic switching between Even Parity check and single error correction-double error detection-triple adjacent error detection (SEC-DED-TAED) codes check. Asynchronous FIFO receiving end data in the gearbox is checked and corrected, even parity code is used in the checking stage; SEC-DED-TAED codes is used in the correcting stage to correct one error, and to detect two random errors and three neighbouring errors. Finally, in order to realize that the user can configure the verification mode of PHY controller, configurable registers are designed at the PCS layer, and the MDIO interface is used to access and write to the registers. The design of RTL level module is completed using Verilog language. The simulation and verification platform is built, and the functional verification is carried out using Modelsim software. Then the results verify the high reliability of the designed model for data transmission.

articleTitle: Fault Clearance Solution for Flexible DC Grids Based on Capacitive DC Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The high equipment costs associated with key components like DC circuit breakers (DCCB) and fault current limiters (FCL) pose a significant challenge. In response, this research introduces a novel circuit breaker topology utilizing capacitors as both current limiting and interrupting units, accompanied by a comprehensive fault clearance strategy tailored for diverse DC fault scenarios. Moreover, the study conducts an in-depth analysis of the interdependencies between voltage and current stresses in fault clearance solutions, energy dissipation in surge arresters, and the relationships with system and circuit breaker parameters. This analysis provides valuable insights for designing circuit breaker parameters. The proposed circuit breaker's fault interruption capabilities are rigorously validated through simulations using PSCAD/EMTDC. Results affirm the swift fault clearance capability of the proposed solution, with the added advantage of lower economic costs when compared to existing DCCB alternatives.

articleTitle: Security Evaluation of Feed-Forward Interpose PUF Against Modelling Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Physical unclonable function (PUF) is a lightweight hardware-safe circuit structure for Internet of Things (IoT). The susceptibility to neural network modeling attacks stands out as a critical consideration in the design of PUF structures. Interpose PUF (IPUF) is a PUF variant that utilises the insertion topology of two levels on top and bottom. In order to enhance the security of IPUF, we propose a scheme to replace the upper and lower XOR APUFs of the IPUF using Feed-Forward XOR PUF (FFXOR PUF). The reconstruction of PUF called FF-IPUF, which will be evaluated for security using two basic neural network models: Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and Side-channel Attacks (SCA). Experiments have demonstrated that the (4,4)-FF- IPUF, with enhanced resistance to MLP and SCA using four loops and separate loop positions, respectively, boasts the advantage of lower attack accuracy when confronted with the same training data.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Model of Battery Swapping Station with Virtual Power Plant Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Battery Swap Stations (BSS) are becoming increasingly important in the electric vehicle energy service ecosystem. In response to the growing need for BSS to participate in virtual power plant programs, we have developed an optimization model to improve battery service operations. This model allows BSS operators to optimize the battery status and its power service activity within stations, ensuring peak performance when needed. Additionally, the model takes into account the intricate performance parameters of the swapping station and incorporates the operator's projections of swapping demand, ensuring that operational strategies align with the station's capabilities and user requirements. Numerical simulations have confirmed the effectiveness and practicality of the model, which provides a BSS decision support tool for increasing profitability and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Indoor Scenes with Self-Calibrated Camera Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an innovative method for 3D reconstruction of indoor scenes, which subverts the reliance of traditional 3D reconstruction on known intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters. While traditional methods achieve impressive reconstruction results by dividing them into two phases, depth estimation and depth fusion, this process usually relies on a priori knowledge, in particular on precise intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters. For this reason, this paper employs a classification model and Gaussian Fourier mapping approach to skillfully predict the camera's intrinsic and extrinsic parameters. In the Truncated Symbolic Distance Function (TSDF) fusion stage, this paper efficiently utilizes the depth information through cascade operations and transforms the TSDF fusion into an end-to-end form, which effectively reduces the noise and reduces the processing complexity. These innovations enable the method in this paper to achieve 3D reconstruction with ideal accuracy despite the lack of a priori knowledge. Experiments on the ScanNetv2 and 7-Scenes datasets show that the method in this paper achieves results comparable to or better than the current state-of-the-art in 3D reconstruction. This not only confirms the effectiveness of the method in this paper in both theoretical and practical applications, but also opens a new avenue for future research on 3D reconstruction in the environment of unknown camera parameters.

articleTitle: Synchronization Stability Analysis and Research on Parameters Stability Region in Renewable Energy Grid-Connected Converter System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Renewable energy grid-connected converters (GCCs) employing phase-locked loops (PLLs) have become the prevailing control scheme in wind and photovoltaic power generation systems, owing to their efficiently, controllability, and flexibility. However, the susceptibility to synchronization stability issues arises from weak grid characteristics associated with long-distance transmission lines. To precisely delineate the synchronous stability boundary concerning control and operating parameters in the renewable energy GCC system, the small-signal linearization model of the system is firstly established in this paper. Subsequently, a synchronization stability criterion is derived by considering the static stability conditions of the system and the operating range of the point of common coupling (PCC) voltage. The parameter stability regions for system operating parameters, encompassing active output power and short-circuit ratio (SCR), along with system control parameters, namely PLL proportion and integral coefficient, are provided. The mutual constraints among the system operating parameters and the system control parameters are elucidated from a mechanistic perspective. Validation of the theoretical derivation is achieved through case study examples, finally, highlighting the impact of system operating parameters and control parameters on the stability of the new energy GCC system based on the stability region of parameters. And the application of the stability region of parameters is demonstrated in the planning and operation of grid-connected new energy systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Localization Detection Technique for False Data Injection Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: False Data Injection Attacks (FDIA) significantly threaten the state estimation of cyber-physical systems (CPS) in the power grid, jeopardizing the secure operation of the electricity system. Currently, most FDIA detection methods are designed for direct current systems, and traditional DC FDIA detection methods cannot effectively detect alternating current FDIA with satisfactory performance. The existing AC FDIA detection methods typically employ time-series measurement data for direct detection, leading to suboptimal detection accuracy. Moreover, these methods focus on detecting the presence of attacks, failing to locate the positions affected by the attacks accurately. To address these issues, this study introduces a deep learning detection model based on Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) for the localization of stealthy FDIA in AC systems. Initially, low-quality data affected by FDIA is removed using a BDD detector. Then, the filtered measurement data is transformed from the time domain to the time-frequency domain using STFT. Finally, the results of the STFT are input into a dual-channel convolutional neural network (DCNN) to extract time-frequency domain features for training and learning, aiming to locate the position of the FDIA attack. Experiments conducted in the IEEE 14 and IEEE 118 bus systems demonstrate that the detection method proposed in this article achieves an average AUC value that is respectively 0.0465, 0.0812 and 0.0255 higher than those of the STFT+BPNN, STFT+LSTM, and STFT+Bi-LSTM algorithms. Furthermore, under various noise intensities and attack strengths, it maintains accuracy, recall, precision, F1 score, and RACC at levels above 0.9036, 0.9425, 0.9588, 0.9506, and 0.899, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Algorithm of Hot Work Based on Target Recognition and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To enable real-time monitoring of fire operations within construction sites and to reduce the chance of fires, this paper proposes a detection algorithm that incorporates target recognition and image processing. Firstly, we add an attention mechanism to YOLO V7 to increase the localization accuracy of highlighted areas. Secondly, we use an image processing algorithm to identify the presence of fire in the localized area and recheck the localized highlighted area to improve the detection accuracy. After the verification is complete, this paper proposes a method based on monocular visual ranging to detect the presence of staff around the fire light to further confirm the authenticity of the fire operation and finally complete the detection of the fire moving operation. To verify the reliability and recognition accuracy of the algorithm, experiments were conducted on the dataset collected at the construction site, including ablation experiments on different target recognition networks and the application of different attention mechanisms. In addition to experiments on image segmentation of different highlighted areas located, and finally, extensive verification experiments on monocular visual ranging experiments are carried out. The experimental results show that the algorithm enables an effective detection of fire operations.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Load Forecasting Based on EMD Decomposition and CNN-BiGRU Heterogeneous Computing Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate and effective load forecasting holds utmost importance in ensuring the secure and stable operation of power grids. To bolster the precision and efficiency of load forecasting models, this research integrates the Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) algorithm to decompose load data into distinct frequency components. Additionally, a novel CNN-BiGRU deep learning fusion model is introduced to capture intricate sequence dependencies within the data. This involves directing different component features to separate models for individualized training. In a bid to optimize efficiency, the study leverages a parallel acceleration platform for streamlined model building and training processes. Subsequently, prediction outcomes from diverse models are amalgamated and synthesized, culminating in the attainment of final load prediction results. To validate the model's efficacy, the approach is assessed through a case study employing load data from a specific station area. Comparative analysis with models like BiGRU and CNN-GRU is conducted. The findings underscore the high forecasting accuracy achieved by the model developed in this study, affirming its capacity to facilitate high-quality ultra-short-term load forecasting.

articleTitle: Study on Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Model Through Deep Learning and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The safe operation of mechanical equipment is the basic requirement in the process of industrial manufacturing, and rolling bearing as an important part of mechanical equipment. Because of the long time operation under complex conditions, it is easy to occur unforeseeable failure. The occurrence of failure, no matter how big or small, will cause economic losses. Therefore, reliable diagnosis of rolling bearings is crucial, and deep learning has become a popular method of mechanical fault diagnosis. In order to improve the accuracy of traditional fault diagnosis methods in rolling bearing fault diagnosis, this paper proposed a 1DCNN-LSTM rolling bearing diagnosis model based on deep learning network theory and technology. In order to improve the impact of unbalanced data set distribution on fault diagnosis, exponential cross-entropy and batch standardization were used to improve the effectiveness of fault diagnosis. The accuracy and superiority of the model were verified by examples to realize the health status monitoring and fault diagnosis of rolling bearing equipment, and thus ensuring the stable operation of the equipment during normal service.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Management Solutions for Neterogeneous Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The rise of personal terminal devices provides users with a wide variety of application experiences, which not only promotes the rapid rise of the wireless communication industry, but also accelerates the pace of technological innovation in the communication field. However, the problem of excessive consumption of spectrum resources brought about by the rapid increase in communication rate has been continuously magnified. The article first analyzes the existing heterogeneous cellular network architecture scheme, and describes a new cognitive heterogeneous cellular network scenario based on this. According to the described characteristics of the network scene, a network resource management scheme that conforms to this scene is studied. It can use mathematical optimization theory to re-model and analyze the above-mentioned scenarios and resource management schemes, and propose a resource allocation algorithm (optimization algorithm) to realize the effective allocation of network resources. Finally, a simulation experiment is carried out under specific parameters of the designed resource allocation algorithm to verify the reliability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Deep Learning Based on Transfer Learning in Image Classification Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of big data and computing power, deep learning models have achieved remarkable results in the field of image recognition, but building and training a deep neural network from scratch often requires a large amount of annotated data and expensive computing resources. This article first outlines the basic principles and challenges of deep learning in image classification tasks. Especially for task scenarios with small samples or scarce annotations, traditional deep learning models are prone to overfitting and insufficient generalization performance. Transfer learning is introduced into this study as an important strategy. Through deep models (such as ResNet, VGG, etc.) pre-trained on large-scale image data sets (such as ImageNet), universal feature representations are extracted. And we transfer these pre-trained model parameters to specific target image classification tasks for fine-tuning. Furthermore, this article elaborates on several typical applications of transfer learning in deep learning models, and analyzes how transfer learning can effectively help improve the accuracy of image classification on the target data set based on actual cases. The experimental part compares the results of directly training a new model and using the transfer learning method to initialize the model and then train on a variety of target data sets. The experiment proves that transfer learning can significantly improve the learning efficiency and final classification performance of the model under limited samples.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Prediction Considering VMD-CNN-LSTM and Migration Learning Frameworks for Poor Data Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: PV power prediction based on historical data and deep learning has been widely used in power systems to improve prediction accuracy. However, it is difficult to establish an accurate PV power prediction model for newly constructed PV power plants due to the lack of historical data. Therefore, based on the migration learning framework, this paper proposes a long and short-term memory network (CNN-LSTM) with the fusion of VMD-CNN-LSTM based on the variable mode decomposition (VMD). Therefore, based on the transfer learning framework, this paper proposes a VMD-CNN-LSTM method for PV power prediction based on the convergence of variational mode decomposition (VMD) and convolutional neural network short term memory (CNN-LSTM). Firstly, VMD is used to decompose the preprocessed historical PV power and meteorological data to reduce its complexity and random volatility; secondly, the decomposed sequences are predicted using a combined CNN-LSTM model, and the prediction results of each component are integrated; finally, Transfer Learning (TL) is introduced to fine-tune the constructed CNN-LSTM model. Through the way of model parameter sharing, the pre-trained model is extrapolated to the data-scarce target PV power plant to realize the migration learning of data features under the condition of few samples. The method is used to conduct experiments on PV power plants in data-poor areas, and the results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve higher accuracy compared with other prediction models.

articleTitle: Association Analysis of Population Health Data Based on Topsis Evaluation Model and XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Residents' physical health is related to a variety of factors, and the study of the main factors affecting urban residents' physical health is of great practical significance for improving residents' health management and reducing the prevalence of chronic non-communicable diseases. In this paper, we pre-process the residents' physical health data by using filling, interpolation and elimination methods, screen the indicators, quantify the residents' living habits by using the Topsis evaluation model with CRITIC weighting, analyze the factors with higher correlation with common chronic diseases by using the XGBoost training classification model. The K-means algorithm is used to classify the residents and give reasonable health suggestions. Finally, the sensitivity analysis of K-means algorithm is carried out. The factors that affect the living habits and the factors that have a high correlation with chronic diseases are obtained, and suggestions are put forward for various groups of people through classification Compared with other algorithms. The evaluation model used in this paper reduces the data dimensionality, and the XGBoost classification used performs well in dealing with large-scale data with high interpretability.

articleTitle: Information Click Prediction Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Information clicks are the basic data support for user recommendation behavior based on big data algorithms, and their accuracy is of great significance to information recommendation on contemporary platforms. Predicting the number of clicks can reflect the user's level of interest in the information, thereby deciding whether to continue to send relevant information to them. This plays an important role in enduring the stable development of the information society. In this paper, we take clicks in the Zhihu data set as the research object. First, we transformed and normalized the data, and then the random forest is used to evaluate the prediction accuracy of clicks based on MAE, RMSE, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> to achieve high-accuracy prediction of clicks. Compared with the BP neural network and particle swarm optimization, the accuracy of the random forest is increased by 10%, which provides a constructive basis for the subsequent development in the field of click prediction.

articleTitle: Resonance suppression of LCL grid-connected inverter based on dual MPC loops
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The large-scale integration of high-power grid-connected inverters poses significant challenges to the power system's electrical energy quality. Optimal Pulse Pattern with Unsymmetrical Switching angles (OPUS) modulation enables effective control of low-order harmonics at low switching frequencies but exhibits slow response and may generate a substantial amount of harmonics when operating under varying conditions. LCL filters can effectively eliminate high-order harmonics but are susceptible to resonance peak issues. This paper presents a dual MPC loop control strategy for LCL grid-connected inverters operating under asymmetric pulse optimization modulation. The inner loop optimally calculates the resonance damping magnetic linkage and superimposes the results onto the offline-calculated reference magnetic linkage. Subsequently, the magnetic flux correction is obtained by subtracting the actual virtual magnetic linkage from the reference magnetic linkage superimposed with the damping magnetic linkage. The outer MPC loop optimally allocates this flux correction to each phase, generating millisecond multiplication quantities by adjusting the phase angles, ensuring that the actual magnetic linkage follows the reference magnetic linkage with the added damping linkage. This approach effectively suppresses resonance peaks in LCL filters while satisfying high dynamic responsiveness. Finally, the transitional process and resonance suppression effects under varying operating conditions are analyzed and validated using Simulink simulation software.

Author Keywords: Optimal Pulse Pattern with Unsymmetrical Switching angles

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Planning Based on Multi-Scenario Technology and Satisfaction Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of conservative planning method of distributed renewable energy (RDG) in the worst scenario of the system, based on multi-scenario technology, a RDG planning method considering scenario satisfaction is proposed. Firstly, based on Coupla theory, a power curve with source load correlation is generated, and the uncertainty of load prediction error is considered. From a data-driven perspective, the lower bound of the p-box is used to describe the short-term load volatility and the degree of the upper bound of the p-box to constrain the load with the long-term development of the society, and multiple scenarios of source load are generated accordingly. Then, considering the economy, the planning benefit index covering the expected income of power supply enterprises and investment companies is established. Considering the coordination, a scene satisfaction index which can evaluate the network loss rate and voltage deviation time by time is established, and then a two-objective optimization model considering economy and coordination is constructed, which is solved by NSGA-2. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed model are verified by an example of IEEE 33-node network.

articleTitle: Research on Automobile Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development and popularization of automotive technology, modern automobiles are equipped with a large number of electronic and mechatronic systems, which makes the diagnosis of automotive faults more complex. The traditional manual detection methods can no longer meet the increasing demand for automobile maintenance. In this study, a neural network-based fault diagnosis algorithm model for automobile external deformation is proposed. In this paper, a dataset containing 8000 images of faulty family minivans and 4000 images of normal cars is constructed. In order to improve the image processing effect, this paper adopts bilateral filtering technique for image denoising to improve the image quality and make it more suitable for subsequent processing. In this paper, ordinary convolutional neural network and DenseNet network models are established respectively. And through model validation, it is found that when DenseNet-264 network is chosen, the model has the lowest error rate and higher accuracy, and the prediction error rate for faulty cars is only 20.6%.

articleTitle: Based on FPGA and CNN gas pedal for picodetopt defect detection algorithm research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of manufacturing industry, defect detection is an important part of product manufacturing. In this paper, the existing PP-Picodetv2 algorithm is improved and adapted to the system hardware, and the IP core of the detection system is designed independently to optimize the system hardware, and finally the CNN network is fused to shorten the detection time. The efficiency and accuracy of the optimized detection algorithm is verified through simulations and experiments. Single prediction time for “picodetopt”: 58ms; Total single prediction time (including pre-processing and post-processing): 82.6ms; Prediction map: 1.5ms: 82.6ms; Prediction map: 95.33%; Refresh frame rate after optimizing the control program is 30.45 FPS: 30.45 FPS. Experimental results can be concluded that the proposed picodetopt defect detection algorithm can meet the production requirements.

articleTitle: Using Data Science to Optimize Business Decisions: Toward a Better Location of a New Business
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: When launching a new business, location is one of the most essential decisions to make. Selecting the ideal location is vital since it instigates high customer acquisition and boosts revenue. Moreover, the presence of competition in a particular area might determine a business's ability to thrive or fail. In this paper, we summarize current research works that suggest a proper location for launching a new business. Based on the research gaps, we propose an innovative system that can help business owners make better decisions regarding choosing the proper place to start a new business. The proposed method gives an approximate percentage of the success rate of launching a specific business activity in a particular location by analyzing similar business activities in the surrounding geographical area. The system also utilizes the power of data analysis and presents a visualized dashboard with seven graphs that help business owners in the decision-making process.

articleTitle: An Integrated Energy Situational Awareness Approach Based on Markov Transition Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Situational awareness is a technology for acquiring, understanding and predicting changes that can lead to changes in the state of a system, and its core goal is to help people better understand the current situation, which requires collecting and integrating from various sensors, data sources and information flows to generate useful data, and then using this data as a basis for predicting and analyzing the next operating state of the model. In order to improve the performance of the model's situational awareness and prediction, this paper proposes a hybrid neural network integrated energy situational awareness method based on Markov Transition Fields (MTF), which analyzes the offset values of the electrical and thermal states of the integrated energy system, and identifies the operating state of the integrated energy system to complete situational awareness. The experimental results show that the system in this paper can reduce the relative error of situational awareness and improve the accuracy of situational awareness.

articleTitle: Impacts of the Endogenous Uncertainty of Wind Power on Power System Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper analyses the impacts of endogenous uncertainty (EU) of wind power on power system reliability. EU of wind power refers to the situation where the dispatch decision of power systems can affect the real-time output uncertainty of wind power. The increasing penetration of wind power raises the concerns of EU on power system reliability. However, the impacts have not been fully investigated. First, the reserve model of wind power generation units is formulated. Then, the model of EU of wind power generation units is given, which illustrates the concept of EU. Thus, a power system reliability assessment method is introduced by integrating the EU model into the conventional power system reliability assessment framework. Case studies are carried out on the modified RBTS test system. Results show that the impacts of EU of wind power on power system reliability grow as the penetration of wind power increases.

articleTitle: Risk Situational Awareness of Power Grid Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of the power grid structure, the risk of power outages is increasing. In order to improve the safety and sustainable operation of the power grid, this paper adopts a deep learning neural network to investigate the power grid risk situational awareness method and proposes a deep learning-based power grid risk situational awareness method to improve the accuracy of assessment. In this paper, various types of power grid environmental factors are considered comprehensively and a power grid risk situational evaluation system is constructed to describe the operational trajectory of the power grid. In order to assess the power grid operation risk situation in the situation understanding stage comprehensively, hierarchical analysis is applied to determine the weights of the indicators. In the situation prediction stage, a deep neural network model is established for predicting the power grid operational risk situation, and the neural network prediction results are analyzed to derive the comprehensive risk level of the power grid in the future. To assess the proposed methods' efficacy, the IEEE 24-bus system was employed as a test case. The study successfully demonstrates the effectiveness of deep learning in perceiving the operational risks of the power grid. This study can serve as valuable guidance for future research in enhancing risk situational awareness.

articleTitle: Road Target Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, machine vision, as one of its key branches, has shown great application potential and value in many fields such as industrial automation, intelligent security, unmanned driving, and medical diagnosis. In this context, target detection, as the core task of machine vision, aims to accurately identify and locate objects of interest from complex scene images. For unmanned driving technology, target detection technology is very important, and whether it can accurately judge road targets determines whether unmanned driving can be realized. With the breakthrough progress of deep learning technology, many target detection algorithms have emerged, and the target detection performance has realized significant improvement in both accuracy and speed. However, there are still some shortcomings such as difficulty in detecting small targets and lack of robustness. In this thesis, a variety of driving scene datasets with weather and location are selected, and the YOLOv8 algorithm is optimized with the BRA algorithm, and its effectiveness is verified after comparing it with a variety of other algorithms.

articleTitle: Lane Line Detection Network Based on Strong Feature Extraction from USFDNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Lane detection technology, as a critical component of autonomous driving and driver assistance systems, has received widespread attention. However, there are still many challenges in practical application. Accurately locating lane lines becomes particularly arduous due to problems such as the diversity of lanes, small occupancy, occlusion, and so on. The SFENet strategically incorporates a Path Aggregation Module before the auxiliary segmentation module. This enhancement empowers the network to delve deeper into capturing high-level semantic information within the image when performing semantic segmentation while comprehensively considering the detailed texture of the image. Furthermore, to address the issue of lane lines occupying a small portion of the image, a Multi-Scale Feature Aggregation Module is introduced before the grouping classification stage. Even on a small scale, this module ensures precise localization of lane lines and the extraction of abundant features by using dilated convolutions with varying dilation rates. Extensive experimental validations show that SFENet outperforms other algorithms in accuracy and robustness. Compared with USFDNet, SFENet achieves a 2.1 \ % enhancement in accuracy (mAP) on the CULane dataset while maintaining a processing speed of 120 frames per second.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer Based Global Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Three-Phase Voltage-Source PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For improving the performance of three phase voltage source pulse width modulation rectifier (VSR) under large signal disturbance, this paper proposes an extended state observer (ESO) based global fast terminal sliding mode control (GFTSMC). The ESO is designed to observe and compensate for the total disturbances which include both the external disturbances and the unmeasured states and modeling uncertainties. The GFTSMC is proposed to enhance the dynamic response of output voltage and reduce AC harmonic content. The proposed control strategy is compared and verified with PI control method and sliding mode control method with exponential reaching law (ERL-SMC) by numerical simulation. The results confirm the superiority of the proposed control strategy in dynamic performance and disturbance rejection.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based System for Monitoring Student Behavior and Analyzing Learning Situations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This text discusses the real-time monitoring of student behavior in the classroom using deep learning technology. By employing DeepSORT to track student postures and recognize interactive behaviors and utilizing the YOLOv8 model to detect student postures, this study constructs an improved deep learning algorithm to establish a classroom teaching evaluation system. Through statistical analysis and real-time monitoring of student classroom states, quantitative assessment criteria have been formulated to accurately evaluate the level of students' concentration. The research results not only provide specific scores for each student's classroom behaviors but also analyze the behavioral characteristics of students and suggest areas for improvement. The study emphasizes the significance of personalized teaching strategies and, based on students' behavior patterns and changes in class, offers tailored behavior correction strategies to enhance the quality of students' attention during lectures.

articleTitle: Low-Power Design of Advanced Image Processing Algorithms under FPGA in Real-Time Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the real-time measurement required for image processing in practice, image processing technology is increasingly supplemented by hardware, such as using DSP (Digital Signal Processing) chips (image processing specific chips). However, when storing and processing large amounts of data, using DSP for image processing also has problems such as slow processing speed and poor real-time performance of the system. This article combines the embedded cache module in the IP core of FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) with the read/write ping-pong structure to store and retrieve image data, in order to save memory space on the chip. The relatively simple algorithm functions and parallel computing of FPGA, combined with a pipeline structure, shorten the image preprocessing time and solve the problem of poor real-time image processing. The experimental results show that due to the increase in workload, the static power consumption of FPGA algorithm design only increased from lW to 1.242W, while the static power consumption of traditional design increased from 1.009W to 1.578W; The dynamic power consumption of FPGA algorithm design has increased from 1.005W to 1.489W.

articleTitle: Discussion on Voltage Frequency of Applied Voltage Test on Transformer and Reactor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The frequency of applied voltage test for transformers and reactors varies in different standards. This paper summarizes the provisions of existing China's standards, IEC standards, and IEEE standards on this issue, and points out the problems of the existing standards. This paper presents the impact of different frequency requirements on the testing equipment in AV testing, and also analyzes the influence of voltage frequency on insulation strength. Suggestions are proposed for providing different specified values for factory test and onsite hand-over test.

articleTitle: Capacity Calculation of Static Frequency Converter for 300Mvar Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For the 300Mva<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r$</tex> synchronous condenser, the static frequency converter is used to start it from 0 to 1.05 times of the rated speed for grid connection under pre-determined time. Based on the type test parameters of 300Mvar condenser provided by the manufacturers, losses during startup process is analyzed and converted into resistance torque. The driving torque curve is designed to have different stages of the startup process for best control of the process. A method is put forward to calculate the SFC capacity so that the startup time of 300Mvar synchronous condenser shall satisfy the requirement and the correctness of SFC capacity calculation method is verified by engineering projects.

articleTitle: Optimization & Reinforcement of Solar Irradiation Strength of Solar Panel through K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The maximum working capacity of photovoltaic cells cannot be maximized because of temperature variations and hence not able to generate ideal electricity if the temperature is less than 25 Celsius and greater than 60 Celsius. In this paper, optimization and reinforcement of solar irradiation is done through K-means clustering. Hot and cold spots in a solar panel can be identified with this technique. The experiment was conducted using a two-axis solar tracking system, and through simulation results, temperature variations were minimized, which resulted in maximum power generation.

articleTitle: The Design of a 4H-SiC SGT MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A SiC SGT MOSFET is proposed to solve the problem of the trade-off relationship between specific on-resistance (Ron, sp) and breakdown voltage (BV), which demonstrated its process flow and some parameters which influence its static characteristics such as EPI Concentration, Shield gate Oxide thickness and so on. In addition, in UIS tests, the avalanche tolerance of the novel structure of the proposed structure is between than that of VDMOS and Trench MOSFET, which may mean the better EAS in practical application.

articleTitle: Facial Image Restoration Algorithm Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved adversarial generative mesh facial image restoration model that addresses problems such as protruding boundaries and blurred textures after repairing damaged areas in facial images. A multidimensional residual module and a self-attention module are used in the sublayer to improve the feature extraction capability. The generator and discriminator are alternately trained on the basis of the opponent loss function and the L1 loss function until the model becomes stable. Comparative experiments on CelebA-based datasets show that the constructed face retrieval algorithm performs better.

articleTitle: AGV Path Planning in Specific Scenarios Based on Improved $\mathrm{A}^{\ast}$ Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Automatic guided vehicle (AGV) is an important part of modern logistics system, and its path planning is the focus of research. In this paper, an AGV path planning method based on improved <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{A}^{\ast}$</tex> algorithm is proposed, which focuses on the problem solving of specific practical scenarios. The weight function of the improved <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{A}^{\ast}$</tex> algorithm is designed according to the actual scenario, and the weight function is added to the priority function of the traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{A}^{\ast}$</tex> algorithm, which can reduce the number of points to be calculated and improve the speed of path search while retaining the quality of the search path. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm only needs to calculate about 42% of the points of the traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{A}^{\ast}$</tex> algorithm when dealing with the AGV path planning problem, thus improving the speed of AGV path search.

articleTitle: Research on a Traffic Signal Control Method Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In modern urban traffic management, traffic congestion is becoming more and more serious, which affects people's travel efficiency and urban sustainable development. The traditional traffic signal control method is to set several timing schemes according to the change of traffic flow, and adjust the corresponding parameters regularly to meet the needs of road users. With the growth of population and the increasing number of vehicles, the traditional time-sharing scheme has gradually shown its limitations, and has been unable to adapt to the change of traffic flow and the impact of emergencies. Therefore, how to optimize and improve the control method of traffic signals, meet the gradually complex traffic environment, improve the traffic throughput of intersections, and alleviate traffic congestion has become an urgent problem for the traffic management department. With the progress of artificial intelligence technology, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has brought an opportunity for optimizing the configuration of traffic signals and provided new technical support for solving traffic congestion problems. Aiming at the problem of low traffic efficiency at single-crossing junctions under the timing control of signal lights, this paper proposes an intelligent control method based on deep reinforcement learning to control the traffic signals of the regional road network by timely detecting the traffic flow, average vehicle speed and queue length of vehicles at the intersection, so as to alleviate the traffic congestion problem at the intersection and improve the traffic efficiency at the intersection of the regional road network.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Monitoring Method of Construction Progress of Power Transmission and Transformation Projects Based on Mask-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The timely and high-quality completion of PTT (power transmission and transformation, PTT) project construction has a decisive impact on the power supply quality and efficiency of the power system. So in the construction of PTT projects, we must do a good job in the management and control of construction efficiency and construction progress. The traditional mode of construction progress monitoring of PTT projects is mainly adopts the manual monitoring mode, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive. In order to realize the intelligent monitoring of construction progress of PTT projects, this study proposes an intelligent monitoring method of construction progress of PTT projects based on Mask-RCNN. This method first uses the marker recognition model based on Mask-RCNN to recognize the markers of key nodes in PTT projects, and then judges the construction progress according to the calculation rules for construction progress of PTT projects. We selected 21 kinds of PTT project markers to carry out experiments, and the results showed that the average accuracy of the marker recognition model based on Mask-RCNN can reach 92.16%, which effectively proved the effectiveness of the model. In addition, this article used the proposed method to analyze the construction progress of the Shiyan Hanshui 500kV PTT project, and the results showed that our method could effectively monitor the construction progress of the PTT project. It proved that our method had great application market and potential.

articleTitle: A heuristic control strategy for reducing rise time in PSM high-voltage power supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As a key system in tokamak, the electron cyclotron resonance heating system (ECRH) plays an important role by providing the high temperature to drive the device and thus a high-voltage power system (HVPS) that provides the energy to power it. With the increase in the energy level required for fusion experiments, HVPS is required to have the ability to raise to a higher voltage level without increasing the rise time. To avoid overvoltage, this paper proposes a heuristic control strategy based on the transient waveform during a single module startup. The possible maximum voltage at the three extremes after module startup is predicted and used to calculate the maximum number of modules allowed to startup at the current moment. Closed-loop corrections are subsequently discussed with the introduction of noise. The final comparison with the active control strategy in simulation shows that the rising edge is shortened by 38% in the absence of noise, and even 33% in the presence of noise introduction, while meeting the HVPS requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Thrust Clearance Detection Model of Main Pump Motor Based on Computer Intelligent Shaft Displacement Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a grating ruler displacement detection system for pump-driven motor based on secondary diffraction optical interferometer is introduced. The position detection mechanism of grating scale of main pump motor is studied theoretically and the corresponding mathematical modeling method is established. The load-displacement equation based on finite element method is proposed. The least square method is used to fit the model, and the model is analyzed statistically, and the corresponding prediction results are obtained. The consistency test and stability test were carried out on a dual-frequency laser interferometry experimental platform. The experiment proves that the working principle of the device is reasonable; The relative error of FBG and laser interferometry is less than 16.67 nm, and the confidence is 0.95, so the test conformity is good. This method is used to test the axial movement detection platform of the main pump motor in a power plant. The research results are valid.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Lossless Compression Method for Harmonic Phasor Measurement Data Based on Golomb Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The harmonic distortion of commutation voltage is one of the important factors that increase the risk of commutation failure. Efficient acquisition and analysis of time-varying harmonic data are crucial prerequisites for analyzing the trends in maximum commutation overlap area and predicting commutation failure. This paper proposes a real-time compression method for harmonic phasor measurement data to improve the harmonic data processing efficiency. Firstly, the characteristics of harmonic data and the phasor angle transformation method are analyzed. Subsequently, a data classification method is introduced, along with a precision-based normalization technique to handle data from different frequency components. Following this, differential coding and Golomb coding are adopted to process measurement data originating from identical frequency components. Finally, the compressed coding values of all frequency components at that moment are assembled. The compression algorithm is tested using a historical dataset of harmonic measurements from a high voltage direct current transmission station. The results demonstrate the method's superior capability in effectively compressing frequency, amplitude, and phasor angle values of the harmonic measurement data.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Infrared Automatic Track-following and Obstacle Avoidance Intelligent Vehicle at Intersection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of urban modernization, the level of motorization has been continuously improved, which has caused a large number of traffic accidents while the travel is convenient and fast. Therefore, it is particularly important to design a smart car that can follow and avoid obstacles and reduce the number of accidents at intersections. At present, most intelligent cars on the market are not designed with any auxiliary functions, low intelligence, high production cost and low stability coefficient, and the experimental results are quite different from the expected assumptions, and cannot meet the requirements of stable, accurate and fast control in different environments. With STC8A8K32S4A12 as the core, this project builds a buck module to supply power to the MCU. The main modules include infrared photoelectric tracking module, metal ultrasonic detection module, motor drive, Bluetooth remote control, etc., which can realize car tracking, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance display, Bluetooth remote control and other functions. It has reference significance for promoting intelligent transportation and safe transportation.

articleTitle: Power Data Service Cost Measurement Mechanism Based on the Whole Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Relying on the power data accumulated by enterprises for a long time, the power data service serves the internal operation of the company and the external service of the government decision-making, etc. And it also plays an important role in the national economic development and the construction of a new power system. Power data service cost measurement can provide decision-making reference for enterprises to study and judge the development trend of power data service. However, the method of measuring the cost of power data service is still blank. Therefore, this paper puts forward the power data service cost measurement mechanism based on the whole life cycle. First, power data services are classified according to their characteristics. Then, the life cycle of power data service is proposed, and the cost composition of power data service is analyzed. Finally, according to the characteristics of power data service, three kinds of power data service cost measurement models are constructed.

articleTitle: Research on User Behavior Classification Method Based on Self Organizing Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The analysis of power user load characteristics based on data mining can provide more accurate demand forecasting for the power market, thereby better meeting user needs. The article quantifies the correlation between different behavioral characteristics and user load through CTGAN - Adaboost data augmentation and Pearson correlation coefficient method, and selects key factors as independent variables for constructing a load interest mining model. On this basis, an unsupervised artificial neural network called Self organizing Map (SOM) is established, which has the ability to map high-dimensional inputs to low dimensions. The clustering results generated by SOM have high visualization and interpretability. Finally, based on the selected behavior features with strong correlation, combined with the aggregated load characteristics, different user interest features are mined in a small sample environment. The numerical analysis shows that the proposed method can obtain more effective and accurate load aggregation results, and can provide reliable basis for demand response to participate in power grid supply-demand balance regulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Framework Construction Method for Day-Ahead Self-Dispatch of Load-Side Virtual Control Units in Response to Dispatch Orders of Main Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper considers the combination of distribution-side distributed small battery energy storage clusters and charging and swapping station aggregates as the virtual control unit (VCU). This paper combines with the existence of the VCU operated by intermediaries in the operation of the actual power system, establishes the optimal model of self-scheduling of the VCU in the day-ahead stage. The model carefully describes the operation mechanism of the VCU and the dynamic time-varying characteristics of the daily operation and regulation capability of the distributed components. It proposes a number of coordination mechanisms for the intra-station self-sufficiency and inter-station mutual aid among flexible resources, so that the optimal allocation of daily dispatch commands issued by the main grid can be accomplished under the task of satisfying the charging and swapping station's own operation. The main contribution of this paper is to propose the establishment method of the optimal self-dispatch model for the distribution side VCU day-ahead to better facilitate the participation of distribution side resources in the active operation of the power system in new type of power system.

articleTitle: Sunspot Activity and Cycle Prediction Study Based on Time Series Algorithm and CNN-LSTM Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study investigates the relationship between sunspot activity and solar cycle variations, utilizing time series algorithms and the CNN-LSTM model for prediction. Initial preprocessing of sunspot number and area data involved outlier elimination and linear interpolation. The ARIMA time series algorithm was chosen for its ability to integrate convolutional neural networks and long short-term memory networks, enhancing prediction accuracy. The model forecasts the current solar cycle from December 2019 to February 2030 and the next from February 2030 to June 2040. Additionally, the study predicts the onset and duration of the next solar maximum and calculates sunspot numbers and areas for the current and upcoming cycles. The research effectively combines temporal and spatial data analysis, offering a comprehensive approach to predicting solar cycle dynamics.

articleTitle: Image Restoration Based on Context Information Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To address the shortcomings of structural distortion and texture blur in existing algorithms for repairing large and irregular semantic damaged images, a diverse aggregation image restoration algorithm based on contextual information is proposed. Firstly, the information of the damaged image is extracted by the encoder to estimate the missing content. After the context information from various receptive fields is merged through the multi-information aggregation block to enhance the structure and texture information of the missing region. Then the original features are restored by the decoder. Finally, the mask matching discriminator is adopted to perform discrimination training on the generated image, and the model is optimized by combining the counter loss, reconstruction loss, perception loss and style loss to promote the generator to synthesize clear textures. Simulation experiments are carried out on the public datasets CelebA and Paris-street. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain clearer and more reasonable structure and texture details, and is superior to the three existing inpainting algorithms in terms of visual effect, PSNR, SSIM and L1 loss.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Large-Scale Renewable Energy on Dynamic Stability After Large Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the deepening of the concept of environmental protection, the traditional power system dominated by thermal generators has gradually transformed into new-type power system dominated by renewable energy. The influence of large-scale renewable energy plants on the dynamic characteristics of the power system cannot be ignored. Based on the actual operating data, the simulation shows that the start-up capacity of renewable energy has a significant impact on the dynamic stability of new energy grid-connected system after large disturbance. In view of the situation, this article focuses on the dynamic stability problem after large disturbance and analyzes the influence of power flow transfer, equivalent inertia and control parameters of new energy on the dynamic stability, which will be verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Whole Scheme of Fast Reactor Ventilation Computer Control System with High Reliability and Configuration Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The automatic control system of fast reactor ventilation is designed. At the monitoring level, various types of sensors are used to detect and collect various environmental information. It is transmitted through the network nodes to the automation control layer of the ventilation system. The environment data of fast reactor are collected and processed in real time. The measured data is transmitted to the industrial computer to realize the automatic control and determination of the fast reactor environment ventilation and air conditioning system. The industrial computer issues the main control commands, and after the PLC control cabinet receives these commands, the fan is automatically controlled by frequency conversion based on fuzzy PID. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can complete parallel processing of large-scale data in 25 seconds. It can intuitively display the environmental information in the mine. The system can automatically control the air supply according to the temperature of the fast reactor environment.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Tracking System Software of Cutting Robot Based on Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies various tracking algorithms based on the characteristics of visual tracking system. According to the characteristics of cutting robot, tangential tracking and normal approximation are studied. An adaptive correction algorithm for motion trajectory of precision cutting manipulator is presented. The algorithm compares it with the PSR fraction to achieve the target tracking algorithm. The translation filter and proportional filter are modified. The device collects image information from CCD equipped with suitable lighting equipment and lens, uses image processing board to preprocess, binarize, compresses and encodes the image information, and then recognizes and interprets it by computer. And by a servo motor and drive to complete a 1:1 linear tracking, experiments show that the image tracking software of the cutting robot designed in this paper can reach the latest discriminative correlation filter tracking method, and it has better adaptability. Experimental results show that this method can achieve target tracking well.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Automatic Reactor Test System Based on T2 Automatic Test Equipment of Intelligent Industrial Computer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This system uses industrial computer as the hardware environment. Using QT as development platform and MySQL as database, an automatic test device for measuring emergency shutdown response time sequence of reactor protection system is developed. It is mainly divided into input test and output test two aspects. The input includes pulse signal output, micro current signal output, analog input, active switch input, passive switch input and speed analog output. The compiler compiles graphical G-Lustre programs into behaviorally equivalent C code, and uses the theorem proving aid Coq to develop the compiler and prove its correctness. In an environment focused on safety-critical software and its formal validation, such validated compilers are extremely important to ensure that source code is semantically equivalent to the object code produced by compilation. The response timing of emergency shutdown of reactor protection system is analyzed theoretically and the test principle of response timing is established. The intelligent T2 shutdown timing analysis system is designed to complete the actual verification work.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Possibility of Power Frequency Current Transformer on Partial Discharge Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In transformer partial discharge detection, HFCT at the core, clamp grounding and bushing end screen grounding is often used to monitor high-frequency discharge current. However, this often leads to problems such as low transmission ratio and reducing end screen grounding reliability. Considering that the power frequency current transformer used in the ascending flange is similar in structure to the HFCT used for high frequency sensing, this article explores the possibility of using power frequency current transformers to sense high frequency discharge current. Firstly, starting from the equivalent circuit, the transmission band of the current transformer is theoretically analyzed. Subsequently, based on the true current transformer used in the 500kV transformer, its transmission impedance, linearity and sensing characteristics of discharge pulses under power frequency high current are tested. The results show that the power frequency current transformer has the ability to sense high-frequency current, has good linearity, and has the possibility of application in partial discharge monitoring in actual operation of the transformer.

articleTitle: A Scheme to Eliminate Synchronous System Effects on Measuring Device in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the widely application of the merging unit (MU), conventional real-time analog data sampling in measuring device is seldom used in smart substation Consequently, a new network sampling method based on fiber-optic network transmission is widely applied, analog data are acquired by remote measure modules and MUs and converted into SV messages. In this method, massive amount of fibers are reduced, all data sharing in substation is realized, and the arrangement is very simple, but it requires high accuracy of the station synchronization system signal. Compared to point-to-point sampling method, reliability of the network sampling method cannot be ensured. In this paper, by analyzing the network sampling data synchronization technology based on electrical reference vector, as well as the influence of the clock synchronization system abnormity on the sampling, measurement calculation and synchronism function of the measuring device is analyzed.
