Aiming at the influence of sampling abnormities caused by synchronous system abnormities on the measuring device, the processing strategies of abnormal interpolation alarm, quality-aided decision-making, automatic frame loss compensation and etc. are proposed. The abnormal interpolation alarm strategy detects the problem that the different MU SV sampling is not synchronized due to the extrapolation of the measuring device during the synchronous interpolation, and issues an alarm in time, masks the abnormal sampling data calculation and the related functions (e.g.: synchronism function), detects and solves the problem in time, so as to avoid abnormal measurement results caused by false synchronization, and avoid control center data abnormity & synchronism abnormity. Quality-assisted decision-making strategy detects whether the synchronization system is abnormal by judging SV data synchronization quality via the measuring device, and provide different processing according to the source of the sampled data, so as to decide whether to mask abnormal sampling data calculation, synchronism and other related functions, thus avoiding abnormal measurement results, synchronism function error, control center data acquisition caused by the synchronization system abnormity. In the automatic frame loss auto-compensation strategy, measured data calculation error caused by the synchronization system abnormality will be auto-compensated by the pre-sampling data in the buffer of the measuring device, so as to reduce the influence on the measurement by the transient synchronization system abnormity. Therefore, reliability of the network sampling and calculation can be promoted, synchronization system effects on measuring device is minimized. This scheme has been implemented in many projects and proven effective.

articleTitle: A Modified AGIMM Algorithm for Target Tracking Based on Maneuver Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the flexible turning characteristics of small unmanned aerial vehicles, an improved AGIMM algorithm is proposed to enhance the robustness of target tracking. The introduction of maneuver detection mechanism can improve the convergence speed of the target by improving the algorithm. The robustness of the algorithm can be improved by extracting historical points at intervals and calculating the turning rate of discrete points. Simulation experiments show that the improved algorithm achieves adaptive tracking of target turning rate, and compared to the traditional AGIMM algorithm, the overall performance of the modified algorithm has been improved.

articleTitle: GNSS/IMU/UWB-Based Train Integrity Monitoring Using Fuzzy Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Integrity of a train is a significant characteristic parameter towards a railway train control system in order to guarantee the railway operational safety. The decoupling event between a locomotive and a carriage or two adjacent carriages has become a serious threat for the following train operating along the same track. Conventional train integrity monitoring solutions based on state detection with specific sensors, like the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver and tail wind pressure unit, may not perform effectively and safely under constrained or difficult operation environments. This paper presents a Train Integrity Monitoring System (TIMS) architecture with integration of GNSS, Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and Ultra-wide Band (UWB) ranging technique. To realize the effective determination of the train integrity state with multiple detection channels, the fuzzy reasoning theory is adopted for decision-making. By using the simulated Head-of-Train (HoT) and End-of-Train (EoT) platforms, both the normal and decoupling scenarios are investigated through experiments. With the practically collected sensor datasets, the different single-sensor-based methods are compared with the presented fuzzy reasoning-based solution. The comparison results illustrate the advanced performance level under the given experimental conditions, which indicate great potentials of the presented solution in novel train control systems.

articleTitle: Research on Online Monitoring and Prediction Technology of Signal Processing Devices in Small Array Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article focuses on the problem of fault monitoring and diagnosis in small array systems. We analyzed the composition of the small array system and BIT settings, and proposed a modeling sensitive parameter set for system health management. Based on the fault sensitive parameter set, we provide a feature processing method and process for sensitive parameters. We use machine learning classification methods and time series methods to diagnose and predict faults in small array systems, respectively, achieving high classification and prediction accuracy. The data analysis results indicate that using data-driven small array systems for monitoring and prediction has good engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: The Study of Motion Control Algorithm for the Wing Mechanism of Solar-Powered Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The paper focuses on the control system of pure solar powered electric vehicle Tianjin No.2 and proposes a double fuzzy controller scheme based on PID control system. The method can provide certain algorithm support for the stable and intelligent operation of photovoltaic support mechanisms with large aspect ratio and large light receiving area. The paper is based on the traditional PID control method of DC motors, proposing a fuzzy processing scheme for three parameters of PID, i.e. proportion, integration, and differentiation. At the same time, the sensing signals from wind and sunlight are also computed with fuzzy processing. Finally, through reasonable determination of parameters, adjustment of fuzzy control decisions, and simulation verification, the results show that the proposed method can provide theoretical and practical support for the stable and intelligent movement of this type of support mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Power Generation Forecasting Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of short-term power generation is the key to improve the efficiency of electric power company. To address the issue of inadequate prediction accuracy by current models, a new short-term power generation forecasting model based on ensemble learning (MSTLEnsemble) was proposed in this paper by combining the complementary advantages of seasonal trend decomposition of local weighted regression, variational mode decomposition, short and long time memory neural network and multiple linear regression. And the model's effectiveness is verified through comparative experiments.

Author Keywords: seasonal trend decomposition of local weighted regression

articleTitle: The Evolution of Spatial Coordinate Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With continuous development of technology, the demand for spatial coordinate measurement has gradually increased. Based on the measurement characteristics, the coordinate measurement system is divided into the centralized measurement system and distributed measurement system and these systems are further classified. Some classical measurement systems are introduced in detail, including the measurement principle, the advantages and the shortcomings. At last this paper introduces the trends of the spatial coordinate measurement system and give a conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Grasping Strategy Based on Deep Learning and K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the robot grasping accuracy and sorting efficiency of the valve body on the butterfly valve automated assembly line, a butterfly valve body grasping strategy based on machine vision and YOLOv3 deep learning algorithm is proposed. Based on the YOLOv3 algorithm, the visual inspection model of the valve body is generated. According to the depth image information and distance between the camera and the valve body is obtained by using the K-Means++ clustering algorithm, then the pose of robot grasping the valve body are estimated. Finally by using the hand-eye calibration method, it obtains the mapping matrix between the valve body coordinate system and the camera coordinate system. Experiments are carried out rapid self-identification detection, positioning and grasping for the butterfly valve body being arbitrarily placed, they prove that the strategies effectively avoided the influence of uncertain factors such as the position and posture of the butterfly valve body in the actual working environment, and the grasping accuracy is high. It provides a reference for the efficient and automated sorting of components in automated production lines.

articleTitle: A method of applying an RFID electronic tag with an IIC interface
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This method retains the original identity identification function of RFID electronic tags while adding an external interface, supporting IIC-bus protocol, based on modular design and the RFID chip radio frequency, tiggers pins and communication interfaces to interact with external devices such as readers and main controllers. When the RFID electronic tag is working, the interrupt signal is triggered and transmitted to the master controller. After the master controller wakes up after receiving the interrupt signal, the master controller can obtain the data in the memory area of the tag chip through the IIC interface and directly perform the relevant operations. In addition, the trigger signal of the electronic tag can also be used for switching circuit control and other scenarios. This method realizes the organic combination of RFID electronic tags and the master controller. Compared with the use of Bluetooth, WIFI and other communication modules, it has the advantages of lower power consumption, lower cost and stronger environmental adaptability, and has expanded functions such as parameter presetting in the case of device power failure.

articleTitle: Research on Key Electrical System of Maglev Train Based on Brake Adaptive Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Suspension control system is the key system of maglev train, and it is also one of the main characteristics of maglev train that is different from wheel-rail train. Its basic function is to ensure a smooth suspension of 8-10 mm between the car body and the rail by adjusting the excitation current of the electromagnetic coil. This project intends to conduct in-depth research on reliability design, anti-interference design, train-track coupling vibration, track step excitation and other problems existing in the current research of suspension control system. The composition, working principle and main process parameters of the main lines and control lines of the ground power supply system and the vehicle power supply system are simply analyzed. The power brake of maglev vehicle is studied and modeled. An adaptive controller based on mechanical brake is established. Through computer simulation, it is proved that the first order adaptive method is superior to the PI method, and the performance optimization of the braking system is realized.

articleTitle: Using a Complete Convolutional Network for the Detection and Recognition of Symbolic Traffic Signs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a traffic sign detection and recognition method based on full convolutional network guidance is proposed. First, a full convolutional network (FCN) is used to distinguish between symbolic and non-symbolic traffic sign areas in images. Then, the object candidate Box method-Edge Box is used to locate symbolic traffic signs, find a small number of potential candidate boxes for symbolic traffic signs, and submit them to the deep Convolutional network classifier for classification. Through this detection and recognition process from coarse to fine, most of the background areas are filtered, and almost all the traffic sign areas are retained. This significantly diminishes the search scope for symbolic traffic signs. The experimental results show that the proposed symbol traffic sign detection and recognition based on the full convolutional network guidance can achieve good detection and recognition effect on different symbol traffic signs, achieving an average accuracy of 98.67% and an average recall rate of 93.27%. The recall rate is very high, the accuracy rate is also high, and it can meet the requirements of real-time.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Door and Window Closing System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This design consists of six parts: power supply, microcontroller circuit, wind detection circuit, water droplet detection circuit, lighting detection circuit, and stepper drive circuit. The first scenario is to open the doors and windows during the day, without rain or wind, and rotate them by a stepper motor for one turn; The second scenario is to close the doors and windows at night or in rainy or windy conditions, indicated by a stepper motor closing for one week; The third scenario: real-time monitoring and control of the stepper motor in case of darkness and brightness, as well as rain; The fourth situation: the triggering of wind triggers the closing of doors and windows once, and can only be reopened after closing, because the changes in wind are uncontrollable. By utilizing the above principles, the effect of automatically opening and closing the doors and windows of the warehouse according to different weather conditions can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Testing of Computer JavaScript Front-End Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, two performance costs of dynamic web page creation and database access are studied. According to the error reporting mechanism of JavaScript engine, CAFJER, a type-guided fuzzy detection algorithm, is proposed. For an implantable program, CAFJER selects a specific class of error information and obtains its situational information by analyzing the dynamics of the program. Secondly, CAFJER generates test cases that can cause errors of the target class according to the content contained. CAFJER imports it into various JavaScript engines for differentiated testing. If there is a different error between the two data, then the two data is likely to be a vulnerability. Finally, CAFJER can screen a large number of repetitive and ineffective cases, thus achieving the purpose of reducing human intervention. A low-cost balancing algorithm based on server and browser is presented. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional JavaScript architecture, this architecture has a great improvement in the efficiency of program execution.

articleTitle: Harmonic-Domain Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis of Single-Phase Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In hybrid AC/DC grids, a bus conversion system comprising of electromagnetic interference (EMI) filters and bidirectional converters is required to ensure energy transmission between DC and AC buses. However, the cascaded system often introduces additional stability problems, which impede the reliable operation of hybrid AC/DC grids. To solve the problem, this paper investigates the cascaded stability of the bus conversion system in hybrid AC/DC grids, and the input impedance of a single-phase inverter is modeled using the harmonic linearization method. The Middlebrook criterion is utilized to determine system stability. Finally, a simulation model is constructed by Matlab/Simulink to validate the analysis conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Pattern Mining and Visualization of Moving Objects Based on Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the popularity of the global positioning System, we have obtained a large amount of trajectory data due to the driving trajectory and the personal user's check-in information on the social network. Trajectory data can be understood as a curve formed in time sequence on a two-dimensional map during the movement of a moving object. Researchers analyze the location, destination and driving conditions of the moving object through trajectory data mining technology. However, it is difficult to analyze the group characteristics of moving objects only through the motion trajectory of a single moving object, so the concept of pattern mining is proposed. This paper focuses on the accuracy and efficiency of mobile object aggregation pattern mining. A clustering pattern mining method based on locus clustering is proposed. Firstly, the density-based clustering algorithm is used for spatial clustering of moving objects, and then the moving object clustering is used to form the spatiotemporal graph. Finally, according to the spatiotemporal graph, the clustering pattern mining algorithm is used to find the moving object clustering set that satisfies the spatiotemporal constraints accurately. This method introduces a spatiotemporal graph data model, which is composed of clusters of moving objects. Each node in the graph contains not only the information of the moving objects that make up the cluster, but also the formation time and position of the corresponding cluster, and each edge records the spatiotemporal relationship between the two clusters. The spatiotemporal graph can accurately reflect the spatiotemporal change characteristics of moving object clustering, and accurately analyze the clustering pattern. Based on the spatiotemporal graph, the algorithm GR is proposed to mine the aggregation pattern of moving objects, which can mine the aggregation pattern according to time and space information. The experimental results show that the proposed method is more accurate than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Detection Based on YOLOv7 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of intelligent driving technologies, target detection, particularly accurate identification of vehicles and pedestrians, becomes crucial. This study focuses on traffic sign detection using the YOLOv7 object detection algorithm, emphasizing efficiency and model architecture. The integration of Mosaic and Mixup techniques for image preprocessing enriches the dataset, enhancing the model's generalization capabilities. Utilizing an enhanced dataset, including traffic sign images under various weather and lighting conditions, the YOLOv7x network was trained and tested. The results indicate high accuracy and robustness in traffic sign detection. The deeper convolution layers and advanced YOLOv7x model demonstrate significant improvements in processing speed and detection accuracy. Moreover, minor adjustments to the network structure further enhance the model's ability to recognize small and partially obscured traffic signs.

articleTitle: A Study of Seafloor Multibeam Detection Planning Based on Grid Segmentation and TLS Plane Fitting Law
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study utilizes the knowledge of plane and three-dimensional geometry to propose key mathematical models and solution methods for the seabed multibeam detection problem. Firstly, this paper derives the relationship between the coverage width of multibeam detection and the overlap rate of neighboring strips and establishes a combined coverage model. The multibeam detection problem is solved by transforming the complex seabed surface into a simple rectangular plane through the grid segmentation technique. In this paper, the mathematical model of coverage width and overlap rate is established, and the expression of iterative relationship is obtained. For the expression of coverage width under different survey line directions, the three-dimensional problem is planarized. A set of survey lines is designed to meet the requirements of coverage and overlap rate. Finally, an area zoning model based on the plane fitting method is proposed to solve the survey line planning problem under complex terrain.

articleTitle: Exploration on Intelligent Detection Methods for Substation Equipment Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of industrial automation and intelligence, traditional methods of substation equipment detection face challenges of low efficiency and accuracy. This study aims to explore a deep learning-based intelligent detection method for substation equipment, aiming to improve detection efficiency, accuracy, and reduce manual costs. The advanced object detection model YOLOv5 is employed in this exploration. Through training and testing on a large number of substation equipment images, rapid and accurate identification of equipment is achieved. Experimental results show that this method outperforms traditional approaches in terms of accuracy, recall, and processing speed, demonstrating promising application prospects. Furthermore, the study delves into the performance of the YOLOv5 model in handling complex scenarios, including its ability to recognize equipment states under various weather conditions and different lighting conditions. By optimizing the model structure and adjusting training strategies, the robustness of the model is enhanced when facing challenges such as occlusion, reflection, and equipment aging. Particularly, the model's capability to detect minor faults is significantly improved, which is crucial for early fault warning and maintenance decision support. In conclusion, the successful application of deep learning-based intelligent detection technology for substation equipment provides new ideas and tools for the safe operation and intelligent management of power systems. Looking ahead, with ongoing technological advancements and further accumulation of data, we believe these intelligent detection technologies will play an increasingly important role in ensuring grid reliability, optimizing operational processes, and reducing operating costs.

articleTitle: A Fusion Algorithm of Relative Orientation for Close Range Industrial Photogrammetry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to satisfy the multiple-baselines and large-dip-angles close range photogrammetry applied in industry, a fusion algorithm of relative orientation is presented. In this algorithm, the initial values of the relative orientation parameters are established by the decomposition of the essential matrix, and then the precise solution of the parameters are calculated by a nonlinear optimization. First, the relationship between the essential matrix and the orientation parameters is derived by the determinant from the coplanarity condition, and then the rotation matrix and translation vector between two images are calculated by singular value decomposition (SVD) of the essential matrix, including the removal of the pseudo solutions. Second, according to the coplanarity condition equation, the cost function of relative orientation parameters for non-linear optimization is build. Finally, the result in comparison experiment indicates that the fusion algorithm has acquired better stabilization and high precision.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Mobile Cloud Cooperation Architecture Using AI Control Software and Hardware
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies the network based distributed mobile cloud cooperation architecture and QoS guarantee mechanism of end-to-end computing and control. By implanting cloud computing resources in the mobile communication network, a near-end low-delay cloud service is formed. This project intends to study the mobile cloud cooperative controller. The control strategy of collaboration with terminal, mobile network and distributed cloud server is studied. This structure can reduce the user's interaction of trust instructions between nodes in the computing process, and reduce the CPU usage and energy consumption of nodes. The distributed mobile cloud computing cooperative controller is introduced, and the perception and computing control decision-making mechanism based on the coordination between terminal, mobile network and distributed cloud server is introduced. This project will provide guarantee for end-to-end mobile cloud services. The experimental simulation proves that this method has good scalability. The simulation results show that the framework has good scalability. It can quickly fix anomalies in collaboration services when they occur. The designed framework has good practicability.

articleTitle: Research on the Simulation of 5G Power Communication Networks for High-Density Access Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the number of power grid terminals and power business data flow, high-density intelligent terminal access scenarios will inevitably become the main application scenario for future power communication networks. The current performance simulation of 5G power communication networks in high-density access scenarios is still lacking. To address this issue, a system level simulation platform has been developed and modeled for the 5G power communication network in high-density access scenarios. At the same time, a scheduling algorithm for high-density power business scenarios has been studied. Finally, performance simulation of the power communication network has been conducted based on the system level simulation platform. On this basis, performance verification was conducted on the user scheduling algorithm studied in this paper. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the data transmission performance of 5G power communication networks in high-density access scenarios.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Algorithms of JRODOS and GNACAS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: JRODOS is one of the widely used accident consequence assessment and emergency decision support systems worldwide, while GNACAS is a representative professional software system in this field in China. This paper selects the site of a nuclear power plant as the research area. On the basis of the same input data (source term of accident, meteorological conditions, calculation area), this paper uses JRODOS and GNACAS for evaluation, compares the calculation results of the two systems, analyzes the reasons for the differences. It can also evaluate the rationality of JRODOS calculation results, and put forward suggestions for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Image Reconstruction Computer Face Recognition System Based on Statistical Pattern Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Multi-directional gradients, fusion and compensation methods are used to generate images that can express the original features, and then a series of processing is done to achieve the purpose of face recognition. Firstly, the gradients in four directions are obtained. Secondly, the gradient is generated by the fusion operation of four gradient values. Finally, the fusion gradient is used to correct the original image, and the complete facial image feature map is obtained. Combined with the characters, the synchronization of voice and voice timing is enhanced to enhance the realism of facial animation. Using the existing speech, text and the speaker's face information, the pre-trained lip discrimination algorithm and video quality discrimination algorithm are presented. It achieves lip animation with high authenticity and synchronizes lip sound simultaneously. Using the Matlab2016 experimental simulation platform, several different types of face sample databases were tested. The experimental results show that this method can achieve better recognition effect under the condition of occlusion.

articleTitle: UAV-TTracker: Multi-object Tracking of UAV Video by Transformer and New Matching Pattern
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) aerial videos hold significant promise in surveillance, rescue operations, agriculture, and urban planning. Multi-object tracking is essential for processing UAV aerial videos, facing challenges like target occlusion, scale variations, rapid motion, and complex environments. Recent approaches use anchor-free object detectors to address identity ambiguity during appearance feature learning. However, classical convolutional neural network-based anchor-free detectors suffer accuracy drops in crowded scenarios. To tackle this, we propose a UAV multi-object tracking algorithm based on the Transformer. The algorithm utilizes the Transformer for local and global interaction in high-resolution input, generating accurate detection information for multi-object trajectory tracking. A GM-PHD method predicts target motion trajectories based on visual detections, and a matching pattern in the data association process enhances model robustness. Comparative validation on VisDrone and UAVDT datasets demonstrates the algorithm's effectiveness, offering a novel solution with broad applications in UAV multi-object tracking.

articleTitle: A Specific Emitter Identification Method Based on Self-Supervised Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Specific emitter identification techniques excel in discerning between various devices through their unique radio frequency fingerprints (RFF), thereby enhancing the efficiency of communication among devices. However, in non-cooperative communication environments, the labeled emitter signal is often scarce or even unavailable. We design an effective self-supervised learning (Self-SL) approach based on contrastive learning for SEI to address the extreme scenario with no labeled samples. Specifically, we employ data augmentation in conjunction with deep neural networks featuring contrast loss to extract generic RF fingerprint features from unlabeled data, enabling the discrimination of various devices. Experimental results demonstrate that the acquired generic features can attain 91% recognition accuracy using just a simple linear classifier.

articleTitle: Research on Attitude Resolution Method Based on Improved Complementary Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the accuracy of the attitude monitoring system of the aircraft horizontal attitude is not high in the process of aircraft jacking, and some staff need to determine whether the aircraft is level through the trim indicator. Therefore, an attitude calculation method based on improved complementary filtering and EKF/KF fusion was proposed. In this method, the data of gyroscope and accelerometer are fused by complementary filtering and PID algorithm, and the obtained attitude data and the output data of the accelerometer are fused by extended Kalman filter. Finally, the heading Angle in the obtained attitude Angle is fused with the magnetometer data by linear Kalman filter to obtain the final attitude. The optimal attitude estimation of the aircraft jacking process is completed.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Method for Joint Denoising and Compression of SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images are usually corrupted by speckle noise, which introduces additional challenges to lossy image compression algorithms. Traditional optical image compression techniques fail to take this scenario into account, resulting in wastage of additional bits for storing undesired speckles and reconstructed images with unpleasant noise. Inspired by these observations, we optimize image compression algorithms to incorporate denoising capabilities, enabling joint denoising and compression of SAR images. Specifically, a novel two-stage training method is designed to transform the raw speckled images into noise-free bitstreams. We further devise a multi-objective optimization strategy to guide the model learning for different objectives in each stage. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing methods in terms of rate-distortion performance when evaluated on both synthetic and real-world SAR datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Scheduling System of Virtual Machine Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies memory real-time monitoring and dynamic scheduling (MMS). The libvirt function library and the libxc function library developed by Xen software are used to solve the problem of VM memory shortage and dynamic scheduling when the memory is idle. The VM migration mechanism is used to solve the problem of server memory shortage. A miniature private cloud computing environment based on Eucalyptus is constructed and applied in practice. Research shows that MMS can realize efficient release of storage resources by implementing virtual machine migration mechanism when host memory is insufficient. The MMS gives it a new maximum storage space. MMS can recover idle storage when capacity is reduced, and it does not have much of an impact on virtual machine performance under 150 MB. Experiments show that the proposed method can efficiently monitor virtual machine storage in private cloud computing environment and realize dynamic allocation of virtual machines.

articleTitle: Big data clustering method based on parallel K-means
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the era of big data, traditional data clustering algorithms have gradually failed to meet the application requirements, and the optimization of data compression and parallelization methods has become a research hotspot. Based on the analysis of the traditional K-means clustering algorithm, this paper optimizes and improves the parallelized K-means algorithm, and proposes the Spark-Kmeans algorithm, which mainly retains the sample set distribution information by random sampling of large samples, and pre-clusters the samples in the nodes, and reclusters the pre-clustering in the convergence node. And it uses this as the initialization clustering center, so as to eliminate the problem of algorithm convergence instability caused by random initialization of the clustering center. Finally, single-node clustering and Spark-Kmeans clustering experiments are performed on the kdd_cup99 dataset and sklearn randomly generated dataset, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by time-consuming, purity, error squared and indexes.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of Zinc Oxide Surge Arresters Based on Infrared Thermal Imaging and Resistive Leakage Current Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Zinc oxide surge arresters are widely used in overvoltage protection due to their excellent nonlinear voltampere characteristics and current-carrying capabilities. However, long-term operation may lead to defects such as heating and a decrease in insulation capacity, posing a threat to the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper addresses the infrared temperature measurement and abnormal full-current online data phenomenon discovered during temperature inspections at a 220kV substation. Through live and power-off tests on zinc oxide surge arresters, the degradation of the internal resistor elements is preliminarily determined, indicating a potential insulation fault. Further dismantling analysis reveals that the sealing rubber ring of the surge arrester has aged, resulting in loss of sealing effectiveness. This causes the zinc oxide valve elements of the surge arrester to be dampened, leading to a loss of its inherent nonlinear volt-ampere characteristics. In response, preventive measures such as strengthening the operation and maintenance of similar equipment are proposed to provide technical support for the safe operation of surge arresters. The comprehensive fault diagnostic method can serve as a reference for analyzing abnormal operation data of surge arresters.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Controlled Load Regulation of Electric Power System Based on Equation of State Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the regulation of temperature-controlled loads (e.g., air conditioning, electric heating) in electric power systems in depth. Firstly, this paper simplifies the partial differential equations for the temperature variation of building rooms into ordinary differential equations for the aggregate parameters and establishes a continuous form equation of the state model of the system, which is more concise and intuitive compared with the traditional differential equations. Subsequently, the continuous-form state equations are transformed into differential iterative equations using bilinear discretization and first-order Eulerian discretization, which are easy to program and solve. Then, the power adjustment strategy of the electric heating equipment is analyzed, and key data such as steady state period, steady-state duty cycle, and average daily power consumption are calculated. Finally, for different outdoor temperature conditions, this paper analyzes the regulation capability of electric heating equipment during peak shaving and valley filling hours and establishes an optimization model to solve the time-varying characteristics of electric heating loads participating in the power regulation, which provides the regulation capability for the electric power system and reduces the cost of electricity consumption at the same time. In addition, this paper also analyzes the problems that may be encountered when electric heating loads and air conditioning loads participate in power grid regulation and propose corresponding solutions.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Littlefs and FATFS File Systems in Smart IoT Electricity Meters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the requirements of a file system for IoT electric meters, specifically focusing on the smart IoT electricity meters used by State Grid Corporation of China. Firstly, the characteristics of IoT electric meters and their file system requirements are analyzed. Secondly, a file system framework and interface are designed for the operating system of IoT electric meters. Next, popular file system types and their features are researched, and a comparison is made between littlefs and FATFS for porting onto the system. The experimental results show that the littlefs can achieve higher reliability and faster read-write speed, being more suitable for the application scenarios. Finally, this paper looks forward to the future trends of file systems for IoT electric meters.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Clearing Optimization Model Considering Maximizing the Consumption of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper explores the mechanism of new energy consumption, proposes a two-stage consumption and clearing model, which can be referred to as the two-stage model, and designs a new energy unit cluster modeling method to be coupled into the clearing model. The first stage of the model takes the maximization of new energy consumption as the goal, and the second stage fixes the commitment and power of new energy as the boundary for clearing again. Finally, the local marginal price is calculated according to the results of the two-stage model, and the validity and correctness of the two-stage model are verified by comparing the calculation results of the classical benchmark model and the two-stage model.

articleTitle: Research on the Community Structure of Combat Systems Under the Conditions of Sudden Attack Events
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The structure and function of the combat system will undergo significant changes when encountering sudden attacks. Timely understanding of the structural and functional characteristics of the combat system under sudden attacks is of great significance for controlling the combat situation and making correct decisions. In view of this, this article abstracts the combat system as a combat network, simulating the combat network after partial node failure under random and deliberate attacks. Then, the multi-scale community detection algorithm based on label promotion algorithm is used to detect the community structure in the network, and the structural and functional characteristics of the combat system are analyzed based on the community structure. This article quantitatively analyzes the characteristics of combat systems under sudden attacks, which provides certain support for the understanding of complex combat systems.

articleTitle: Study on Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting Based on SSA-LSTM-AdaBoost Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Power load forecasting is of great significance and plays a vital role in the safe operation of the power system and the stability of power supply. Aiming at the problem of low prediction accuracy of single model, this paper proposes a prediction model based on the combination of Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) optimized Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) and integrated algorithm. Multiple weak learners are first integrated through the AdaBoost algorithm to capture patterns and features in the data from multiple perspectives. Secondly, the collective intelligence and group collaboration ability of the SSA algorithm is utilized to ensure the global convergence of the algorithm, thus improving the prediction accuracy and robustness of the LSTM model. Finally, the model is analyzed and compared by examples to verify that the prediction accuracy of the model has been further improved.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Impact of Measuring Distance on Infrared Temperature Measurement Accuracy in Low-Temperature Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Infrared temperature measurement is an important method for live detection of power equipment. The ambient temperature and temperature measurement distance are the main factors that affect the accuracy of infrared temperature measurement. In order to study the impact of temperature measurement distance on the accuracy of infrared temperature measurement in low temperature environments, this article collected temperature data within a distance of 20m at intervals of 2m at laboratory room temperature and outdoor low temperature environments. Through function fitting, the changing relationship between measured values and true values at different distances is analyzed. The experimental results show that compared with room temperature environment, the infrared temperature measurement value in outdoor low temperature environment decreases more and faster as the distance increases. A smaller temperature measurement distance can produce larger errors in the infrared temperature measurement results. Unlike the absolute temperature value, the temperature difference is relatively less affected by the ambient temperature, and its maximum error is 1.1°C within a range of 20m. Therefore, using relative temperature difference as the judgment criterion when carrying out long-distance infrared temperature measurement in low-temperature environments will be more conducive to the judgment of heating defects.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal Aging Insulation Characteristics of Transformer Oil-Paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The insulation aging of rectifier transformers is one of the significant factors affecting the stable operation of the power grid. To clarify the aging mechanism of transformer oil-paper insulation, establish measures for aging prevention and deceleration, and enhance the reliability of electrical equipment operation, this study summarizes the characteristics and variations of recent thermal aging products of oil-paper insulation. It emphasizes the influence of moisture on transformer oil-paper insulation and summarizes the electrical characteristics of transformer thermal aging. This research provides technical insights for the long-term stable operation of transformer oil-paper insulation equipment.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Reported Capacity Optimization and Operation Strategy of Electrical Fused Magnesium Group Furnace in Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: For obtaining the maximum benefit, the Electrical Fused Magnesium Group Furnace (EFMGF) participate of power system Frequency Regulation Auxiliary Service (FRAS), need to combine their own operating characteristics to develop participation in the service of the operation control strategy, and consider the regulation characteristics and multiple uncertainties to build model for Day-ahead Reported Capacity (DRC) optimization of EFMGF participate in the Primary Frequency Regulation (PFR). Based on analysis of the characteristics of energy use, operating characteristics and adjustment characteristics, the control mechanism for the EFMGF participate in the PFR is proposed and the Frequency Regulation (FR) characteristics of the Electrical Fused Magnesium Furnace (EFMF) is deduced accordingly. With the goal of maximizing the overall profitability of the Electrical Fused Magnesium Enterprise (EFME) and taking into account the quality of products, the limitation of the energy requirement and the demand for FR, the optimized model for FMGF participate in the PFR is established to optimize DRC. Aiming at the multiple uncertainty problems such as the uncertainty of time and power and the randomness of the frequency regulation signals (FRSs) in the conversion of the operating conditions of the EFMF, a two-dimensional scenario matrix is constructed, which can be realized to solve the optimized model containing complex uncertainty factors. Simulation cases verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, and the proposed optimized model can obtain the optimal reported capacity.

articleTitle: Analysis and theoretical research on waste heat recovery technology in thermal power plants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The potential for energy conservation through waste heat recovery in power plants is substantial. Scholars, both domestic and foreign, commonly employ low-temperature economizers, power cycles, and absorption heat pump technologies to recover low-grade waste heat in thermal power plants. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of current waste heat recovery methods, exploring the development vision for waste heat application in thermal power plants. It focuses on two key aspects: breakthroughs in key technologies and the comprehensive utilization of energy. The proposed waste heat recovery theory aims to extend the use of waste heat temperature and promote refrigeration through power generation waste heat.

articleTitle: A Drone Swarm-Based Wildfire Search and Rescue Method with Autonomous Behavior Modeling and Centralized Task Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Forest fires spread rapidly with severe consequences, making timely and effective fire monitoring and personnel rescue crucial. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms play a significant role in this scenario. To address the challenge of swarm control, we propose a centralized task assignment method with feedback based on behavior tree and communication link. This approach achieves collaborative task scheduling while preserving individual autonomy. For search behavior, we introduce a heat map search strategy suitable for vertical camera shots, along with optimal parameter selection. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed swarm control method and optimized search strategy effectively accomplish the task, significantly reducing personnel rescue time by nearly half.

articleTitle: Research on Finite Element-Based Zero-Value Insulator String Heating Identification Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: To investigate the thermal distribution characteristics in insulator strings incorporating zero-value insulators, this study selects seven XP-70 type suspended disc insulator strings as the focal subjects. A sophisticated finite element simulation was employed to develop a coupled electric-thermal multiphysics model, aimed at examining how zero-value insulators influence the electrical potential and thermal distribution across various segments of the insulator strings. The findings reveal that standard insulator strings exhibit a relatively narrow temperature fluctuation range, whereas those with zero-value insulators demonstrate a significantly wider range. The study also observed that the placement of zero-value insulators variably impacts the thermal distribution along the strings, yet consistently proves effective in their identification. Importantly, this research substantiates the feasibility of employing infrared thermal imaging for detecting zero-value insulators, offering vital theoretical backing for such detection methods and enhancing the reliability of infrared-based diagnostics in this context.

articleTitle: Design of LSTM-Based Anomaly Warning System for High-Voltage Transmission Cable Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: High-voltage transmission cable joints abnormal warning is easily affected by harmonic currents, resulting in poor warning effect. For this reason, a high-voltage transmission cable joints abnormal warning system based on LSTM is designed. We need to detect the abnormal current harmonics of high-voltage transmission cable joints, and obtain the dielectric state of cable joints. This paper designs CC2430 microprocessor warning module, responsible for processing the current data in the warning area, builds ground wire current detection Detection module, which is responsible for evaluating cable joint anomalies. We also construct the LSTM neural network warning model, compare and analyze the realtime status with the detection point status in the model, and obtain the prediction value of the current cable joint status. By comparing and analyzing the realtime status and the detection point status in the model, we obtain the prediction value of the current cable joint status. The moving average technique is used to analyze the overall change direction of the current data and determine the relationship between the current prediction data and the threshold value. This paper determines the relationship between the current prediction data and the threshold value, and distinguishes the abnormality level according to the color of the system indicator. From the experimental results, it can be seen that the maximum current value of the system is 125 A, and the change curve is consistent with the actual curve. The value is 125 A, and the change curve is consistent with the actual curve, which indicates that the warning effect of the system is good.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Energy Storage Systems in Distribution Networks Based on Improved Imperial Competition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The configuration of energy storage system in distribution network has become a hot spot in research and application. Considering its operating income and cost, the optimal allocation model of energy storage system is established. The improved imperialist competition algorithm is used to find the optimal solution of the model. The improved Imperial Competitive algorithm introduces Lévy flight behavior in the process of colonial assimilation to calculate the movement position of colonies, and proposes a migration mechanism for imperialist countries to accelerate the convergence process. The effectiveness of the model and algorithm is verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Road Crack Detection Based on Improved UNet Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of urban infrastructure, timely detection and maintenance of road cracks have become crucial tasks to ensure road safety and sustainable development. In order to enhance the detection accuracy of road crack detection, this paper proposes an improvement to the UNet network specifically tailored for road crack detection. Firstly, we introduce the attention mechanism (CBAM), which helps the model better handle variations in road cracks at different scales, thereby enhancing the network's representational capabilities. Secondly, we adopt the DCNv2 network architecture, incorporating learnable offsets and deformable convolutions to adapt convolutional operations more effectively to the non-rigid shapes of the targets, improving the model's perception of fine structures in the images. The proposed algorithm is tested on a publicly available dataset of concrete crack images. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to the original UNet network model, the proposed approach achieves a 3.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> increase in recall and a 6.5% improvement in accuracy.

articleTitle: A Radar Net Layout Method Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the maximum warning range of radar networks, an optimization algorithm for radar network layout based on improved genetic algorithm is proposed. First, a joint early warning probability calculation model for multiple radars was established. Subsequently, a detailed process for calculating early warning using the Monte Carlo method for radar networks was presented, and an improved genetic algorithm was proposed for solving the problem. The improved genetic algorithm mainly improves on the roulette algorithm, DNA selection, crossover, and mutation. Simulation experiments show that the improved algorithm improves the convergence speed.

articleTitle: Design and application of a portable electric power distribution gateway operation and maintenance test tool based on cloud edge collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As the key equipment of the intelligent electric power distribution room, the electric power distribution gateway is the main equipment to realize the distribution IoT. In order to ensure its normal operation, regular operation and maintenance are required. At present, the research on the operation and maintenance technology of the intelligent electric power distribution room mostly focuses on the detection of the communication protocol of the intelligent terminal and the design of the operation and maintenance master station platform, while the research on the on-site operation and maintenance tools of the electric power distribution gateway is difficult to find. Therefore, this paper studies this technology. First, based on the architecture of “cloud management edge and end” of the electric power distribution IoT, the automatic closed-loop test architecture of cloud edge collaboration is designed, and the cloud edge collaboration function of the portable operation and maintenance test tool is defined. Secondly, the software and hardware design as well as the portable design of the on-site portable operation and maintenance testing tools were elaborated, ensuring the lightweight and portable operation and maintenance tool while ensuring the cloud edge collaborative operation and maintenance testing function. Finally, the feasibility of the technology is verified by field application, and the intelligent operation and maintenance level of the electric power distribution gateway is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Control Based on Intelligent Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: According to the force and motion analysis principle of vertical flight, roll flight, pitch flight and yaw flight of quad rotor UAV, the mathematical model is established, the appropriate reference coordinate system is selected. And the quaternion method is selected as the carrier to describe the attitude of quad rotor UAV, and the relationship between quaternion and attitude Euler angle in the space coordinate system, namely roll angle, pitch angle and yaw angle, is constructed as the input of subsequent attitude control. This paper reasons the change matrix when the airframe coordinate system and navigation coordinate system are converted, establishing a nonlinear dynamic model, combining the complementary filtering algorithm and the extended Kalman filtering algorithm to fuse and estimate the collected data. Combining the cascade PID controller, taking it as the frame, and adding the intelligent fuzzy control theory internally, the three values Kp, Ki, Kd of the PID parameters can be adjusted in real time. In this way, the UAV can have better robustness, and the flight control system can intelligently change parameters according to the actual flight situation of the UAV to achieve the optimal control effect. Then, the roll angle, pitch angle, yaw angle and position information of the UAV under PID control mode are simulated through MATLAB/Simulink module. The results show that the optimized PID parameters of fuzzy control have good control ability for attitude angular rate of four rotor UAV and better position control for UAV.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Time Series Analysis for Anomaly Pattern Detection and Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The interpretability of multivariate time series anomaly detection is crucial for understanding the reasons behind anomalies, enhancing the usability and credibility of models, and ensuring successful real-world applications. Although there has been considerable research on the interpretability of time series, most are based on black-box models and have certain limitations in revealing the underlying patterns of anomalies. To address this issue, this paper focuses on identifying anomaly patterns in multivariate time series using a white-box machine learning approach, which overcomes the interpretability limitations of traditional methods in high-dimensional dynamic data processing. This approach innovatively enhances the application of Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) in higher dimensions to effectively capture anomaly patterns of any length, while identifying both short-term and long-term anomalies. Experiments on the Yahoo dataset demonstrate its high accuracy and reliability in anomaly pattern detection, particularly in explaining the reasons and impacts of identified anomaly patterns. This innovation marks a breakthrough in anomaly pattern interpretation, showing significant practicality and interpretability in real-world applications, and provides vital support for decision-making and predictive modeling in time series analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Analysis and Remote Fault Diagnosis Technology of New Large Capacity Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Synchronous condensers offer significant benefits in large reactive power capacity and strong voltage support ability, which can effectively solve prominent problems such as commutation failure and voltage drop of ultra-high voltage DC converters. They are increasingly widely used in power grids. However, the large-capacity condenser has a large volume and complex structure and is prone to faults, which urgently requires research on fault feature analysis and diagnosis technology. This article analyzes the features of large-capacity synchronous condensers and their engineering advantages, such as increasing the short-circuit ratio of the receiving power grid, improving the transmission limit power, working in a forced excitation state for voltage support in the event of a commutation failure at the UHVDC receiving end, absorbing excess reactive power to suppress sudden voltage rise during DC blocking, and providing dynamically adjustable reactive power support for the AC power grid through flexible switching of late or leading phase states. This article provides common faults, such as mass imbalance, misalignment, friction, oil film oscillation, etc. At the same time, the fault characteristics are analyzed using computer simulation analysis, laboratory simulation analysis, and on-site measurement testing methods. A standard fault diagnosis method for synchronous condensers is proposed on this basis, utilizing fault pattern recognition and credibility evaluation. By establishing a library of fault models for the synchronous condenser and employing time-domain and frequency-domain signal analysis techniques, the credibility and nature of the fault are determined by calculating the instantaneous values and rate of change of the sampled signal using eigenvalues. Through the comparison and analysis of pertinent standards and historical data, the severity of the fault is ascertained, along with the trend and severity of the problematic synchronous condenser. The findings of this study have additionally advanced the progress of fault diagnosis technology for synchronous condensers with large capacities.

articleTitle: RemoteBlock: A Scalable Blockchain Storage Framework for Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper addresses the continuously increasing storage demands challenge faced by blockchain networks, with a particular focus on Ethereum. We propose a novel framework that divides the network into consensus nodes, which inherit Ethereum characteristics, and storage nodes responsible for storing Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT) nodes. This design aims to reduce the storage load on individual nodes by distributing MPT nodes based on their key values. Our approach maintains network security and data integrity while easing the storage burden through a distributed storage mechanism. Key to our work is the dynamic adjustment of storage load across an expandable network of storage nodes. We validate our framework through practical experiments, involving modifications to the go-ethereum source code and testing with authentic Ethereum block data. The results confirm that our work not only mitigates storage issues but also enhances synchronization efficiency.

articleTitle: A Hosting Capacity Assessment Method for Distributed PV Considering Inverter Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Over-voltage is the major concern of constraint when assessing the maximum PV that can be integrated into the distribution network. A hosting capacity calculation methodology considering PV inverter voltage control based on fair rule is proposed in this paper. The method utilizes a dual binary searching algorithm in which the PV capacity and reaction power output of inverter are both changed iteratively. Using a testing distribution network, the proposed method is compared with other typical methods based on stepwise searching strategy and constant-power-factor inverter control mode. The precision and computational effectiveness of the proposed method is thus verified through comparison results.

articleTitle: Research on Face Recognition System Based on Intelligent Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces a real-time face detection technology based on TMS320C6201. Through the confidential communication between each subsystem, the synchronization of each subsystem is completed, and the real-time face recognition, feature code extraction, and the closest face matching are carried out. Firstly, Grabcut foreground extraction method is used for pre-background segmentation of recognized images to reduce external interference, and then face detection and identification are carried out according to the segmentation effect. A parallel MPI program is developed by transforming the traditional serialization-based face information updating method into a parallel method. This paper applies existing MPI-based methods and existing web-based facial information acquisition methods to improve the efficiency of existing face recognition technologies. It realizes the distributed processing of the update algorithm in the original face recognition system and enhances the ability of the system to process a large amount of data to achieve the purpose of improving the system performance. The experimental results show that the system combining grab cut and Adaboost algorithm can improve the recognition rate and detection rate, and the recognition speed is faster.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Power Grid Digital Model Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A microservices-oriented grid digital dispatching data service platform is proposed. It is a multi-level integration method of object-oriented, user and application. This paper realizes the separation of data processing business and exchange function. This method can effectively reduce the complexity and coupling of information exchange between service systems in power network scheduling. At the same time, this platform can also eliminate the differences between different manufacturers, different operating systems, different programming languages in different systems, and realizes the seamless docking of power grid data.

articleTitle: Research on the Lookup-Table Method of Power-over-Fiber System for Maximum Power Point Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Power-over-fiber (PoF) system has a superior electromagnetic insulation property, which can power sensors in high voltage and strong magnetic environments. When the load and laser intensity of the system change, the traditional perturbation and observation (P&O) maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm has a slow response speed and significant steady-state fluctuation. Therefore, this paper proposes a MPPT algorithm based on the lookup-table method. This method first collects the maximum power point (MPP) under different laser intensity and load conditions and forms a lookup-table. When the system is working, it obtains the value of the operating point through the lookup-table. When the laser intensity or load changes, this algorithm effectively increases the speed of the system's tracking of the MPP and reduces the output voltage fluctuation. The gallium arsenide cell model was built in MATLAB/Simulink and a simulation experiment of the algorithm was carried out. The results show that under the conditions of sudden changes in laser intensity and load resistance, the lookup-table method improves the response speed by 6.7 times and reduces voltage fluctuations by 34% compared to the traditional method.

articleTitle: FCP_DIS_ViT: Efficient Vision Transformer with Neural Network Pruning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Benefiting from the self-attention module, the transformer architecture exhibits extraordinary performance in many computer vision tasks. Compared with mainstream convolutional neural networks, visual transformer usually has a complex structure for extracting powerful feature representations. Although the network performance is improved, it usually requires more computational resources and is more difficult to develop on mobile devices. This study explored the feasibility of implementing the model compression algorithm on the visual transformer and proposed a visual transformer pruning method, which can identify the influence of dimensions in each layer of the transformer and then perform the corresponding pruning. This paper automatically represents important dimensions by promoting the sparsity of the transformer. To achieve higher pruning rates, we can crop many dimensions which have smaller importance scores, without significantly reducing the accuracy. The procedure for pruning visual transformer involves three main steps: (1) incorporating sparse regularization during training; (2) reducing the dimensions of certain features in accordance with a predetermined pruning ratio; and (3) conducting fine-tuning. The parameters of the suggested algorithm, as well as the number of floating-point operations per second, have been thoroughly assessed and analyzed using the ImageNet datasets. This experiment have confirmed the efficacy of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Project Symbiote: Towards an Internal Personal Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Humans encounter complex calculations daily. However, generally-speaking, humans are poor at complex calculations on their own. It is well-known that the average human is only capable of calculating the answer to simple numerical expressions (SNE's). And, when tasked with more complicated NE's (CNE's), we often struggle. To aid us, we have developed calculating devices, or CD's. Historically, humanity's CD-of-choice has evolved, over time, from the abacus, to the modern-day handheld calculator, where it has stayed, relatively, unchanged. However, we should find it necessary to continuously-improve our CD, to the point where complex calculation is not a hassle for us; It is effective, and also a second-nature to us, a built-in feature of humans. In particular, the handheld calculator's evolution can be taken further, by integrating the calculator into the human brain, itself, providing a significantly, more seamless experience. In this project, I worked towards this with Symbiote: a practical brain-computer interface (BCI) capable of assisting a human with calculating CNE's. By simply thinking, sequentially, about the characters involved in their desired CNE, a human is able to cue Symbiote to decipher each character in the CNE (which, Symbiote is capable of doing with relatively-high accuracy) evaluate the NE, and audibly play the answer to the CNE, via a bone-conduction headset, in their ear. All in all, Symbiote represents the fusion of biological, and synthetic, intelligence to create a new, powerful hybrid entity. As just an elementary proof-of-concept, Symbiote achieves considerable success, paving the way for future, higher-order BCI-based cognitive enhancement in humans.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Warning for Small and Medium Sized Equipment Based on AdaBoost SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the establishment of modern enterprise production systems, enterprises attach more importance to the management of machinery and equipment. Using certain technologies to predict possible faults in machine production and repairing machinery and equipment in advance based on predictions is an important guarantee for the continuity of enterprise production and operation. The most common production equipment in oil and gas field exploitation is small and medium-sized rotating equipment. The normal operation of the equipment is conducive to ensuring the smooth implementation of oil and gas field production and is an important equipment foundation for ensuring stable production. With the establishment of the management system for production machinery and equipment in oil and gas fields, oil and gas field enterprises will monitor the data of small and medium-sized rotating equipment, collect operational data of small and medium-sized rotating equipment, and store it, providing a foundation for establishing machine learning methods to early warning of faults in small and medium-sized rotating equipment.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: An Equivalent Modeling Method for Modular DC Energy Dissipation Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The complex simulation calculation process and slow solving speed are important factors that constrain the development of modular multi-level device simulation modeling. In this paper, the equivalent modeling of modular DC energy dissipation devices is analyzed, and a simplified modeling method based on the Thevenin equivalent is proposed. The proposed method equates the modular DC energy dissipation device bridge arm to a Thevenin equivalent circuit, which can accurately simulate the equivalent circuit of the locked bridge arm while significantly reducing the number of computing network nodes. The established mathematical model has been verified through the Rudong HVDC project simulation model.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Gearbox Oil Health Assessment Method Based on Deterioration Rate Variable Weight Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the health status of wind turbine gearbox oil, a comprehensive health evaluation method of lubricating oil based on multi-indicators deterioration and deterioration rate variable weight correction was proposed. Firstly, based on the oil inspection data, the grey relational analysis (GRA) is used to calculate the constant weight of each indicator, and the variable weight is calculated according to the deterioration and deterioration rate of multiple indicators. Then, fuzzy linear transformation is used to calculate the relative deterioration degree of each indicator. Finally, the health status of different lubricating oils was evaluated by using the variable weight vector and the indicator deterioration degree results. Based on three kinds of oil inspection data of three wind turbines that have been working continuously for 1.5 years, the health status of different lubricating oil under the same operation time was compared and analyzed. The results show that the proposed method can effectively evaluate the health status of different lubricating oils, which has important reference significance for the selection and replacement of lubricating oil in wind turbine gearbox.

articleTitle: Research on Force Control Strategy for Spinal Surgery Robots Based on Adaptive Impedance and Virtual Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Spinal stenosis is one of the leading causes of lower back and leg pain, and effective treatment often involves the removal of lamina and ligamentum flavum. However, the surgical procedures are characterized by prolonged durations and demand a high level of precision from the operating surgeon. Therefore, this paper proposes a direct force control method for robotic grinding of lamina. This method involves an analysis of the force variations during bone grinding, leading to the development of force control strategies suitable for two different lamina grinding scenarios. For the lamina leveling operation, a constant force control strategy is introduced. For the drilling operation, a strategy involving the implementation of virtual gradient stiffness during grinding is proposed. The expression for virtual gradient stiffness is derived, considering the end-effector force smooth control. A compliance controller is employed to regulate the end-effector force. Finally, the proposed control algorithms are subjected to numerical simulations using MATLAB software. The simulation results demonstrate the efficacy of the control algorithms in addressing the challenges of maintaining constant force on complex surfaces and handling force discontinuities during grinding of objects with different stiffness.
